_meta.purpose: Consolidated knowledge base the AI fix suggester consults BEFORE inventing values. Combines: field constraints (regex/length), tag templates (exact XML structures per message type), dependency rules (cross-field invariants), error-code catalogue with fix recipes, date-fix rules, tag insertion-order maps, and high-quality dummy data. Always prefer this file's data over hallucinated values.
_meta.xsd_version_coverage: Rules derived from: pacs.008.001.13, pacs.009.001.12, pacs.003.001.11, pacs.002.001.12, pacs.010.001.06, pain.001.001.12, pain.002.001.14, pain.008.001.11, camt.052/053/054.001.13, camt.055.001.12, camt.056.001.11, camt.057.001.08. All rules are backward-compatible — they also apply to older minor versions (e.g. pacs.008.001.08, pacs.008.001.09, pacs.008.001.12) unless explicitly noted otherwise.
_meta.bizsvc_note: SR2023/SR2024 uses BizSvc='swift.cbprplus.02'. SR2025 uses BizSvc='swift.cbprplus.03'. Both are valid — the validator enforces the version that matches the document's namespace URI. The BIZSVC_V03_TO_V02 auto_fix_rule only triggers when the validator is configured for SR2023/SR2024 compliance. Do NOT apply this rule blindly for SR2025 documents.

field_constraints._doc: Per-field validation rules. type=regex algorithm name. min/max are character limits unless noted.

BICFI.xsd_source: BICFIDec2014Identifier — confirmed across pacs.008.001.13, pacs.009.001.12, pacs.002.001.12
BICFI.notes: 8 chars (AAAABBCC) or 11 with branch code (AAAABBCCDDD). First 4: institution code (A-Z0-9). Next 2: country (A-Z). Next 2: location (A-Z0-9). Optional 3: branch (A-Z0-9). Banks-only ISO 9362. Pattern does NOT allow lowercase.

AnyBIC.xsd_source: AnyBICDec2014Identifier — same pattern as BICFI, used in OrgId/AnyBIC
AnyBIC.notes: Same format as BICFI. Used for legal entity identification in OrgId.

IBAN.notes: ISO 13616, country-specific length. First 2: country code (uppercase). Next 2: check digits (numeric). Remaining: BBAN (alphanumeric, country-specific). XSD allows lowercase in BBAN but SWIFT normalizes to uppercase.

LEI.notes: Exactly 20 chars: 18 alphanumeric (A-Z0-9) + 2 numeric check digits. ISO 17442. Validated using MOD 97-10 algorithm.

Ccy.notes: Exactly 3 uppercase letters. ISO 4217 currency code. Lowercase is invalid — always uppercase.

Ctry.notes: Exactly 2 uppercase letters. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Lowercase is invalid.

UETR.notes: UUID v4 — mandatory in pacs.008/009 under CBPR+. Pattern: [0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}

BizSvc.notes: CBPR+ uses swift.cbprplus.02 for all SR2025 payment messages (pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, pacs.003, pacs.004, camt.056, etc.). The value swift.cbprplus.03 is NOT valid for SR2025 — it is a fictitious value sometimes inserted by mistake. Always use swift.cbprplus.02.

MsgDefIdr.notes: Must match the document namespace exactly.

Nm.notes: SWIFT chars only: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + space

AdrLine.notes: Max 2 lines allowed; each max 70 chars.

NbOfTxs.notes: Must equal the count of CdtTrfTxInf / TxInfAndSts blocks.

CdtDbtInd.notes: Credit/Debit indicator. CRDT = credit entry (money received), DBIT = debit entry (money sent). Mandatory in Ntry, TxDtls, Bal, and several camt elements. Default to CRDT when context is ambiguous. Applies to camt.052, camt.053, camt.054 and other camt messages.

NbOfNtries.notes: camt statement/notification: total number of Ntry elements in the message. Auto-computed by counting <Ntry> elements. Applies to camt.052, camt.053, camt.054. Optional (minOccurs=0) but must not be empty if present.

PgNb.notes: Pagination page number in StmtPgntn. Default to 1 when empty. Part of camt.052, camt.053, camt.054 statement pagination block.

LastPgInd.notes: Pagination last-page indicator in StmtPgntn. Must be 'true' or 'false'. Default to 'true' when empty (single-page statement). Part of camt.052, camt.053, camt.054.

IntrBkSttlmDt.notes: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or future. Fix: replace with today's date.

ReqdExctnDt.notes: pain.001 PmtInf/ReqdExctnDt accepts EITHER a plain date (<Dt>) OR a datetime (<DtTm>). Must be today or future. AI should use <Dt> form by default.

CreDtTm.notes: CBPR+ format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. No Z. No milliseconds.

BirthDt.notes: Must be in the past (before today).

ChrgBr.notes: SLEV disallowed by policy; default = SHAR.

SttlmMtd.notes: INGA = settled on books of instructed agent.

BtchBookg.notes: When true, all transactions in the batch must settle as one. All CdtTrfTxInf blocks MUST share the same IntrBkSttlmDt. AI CANNOT auto-fix cross-transaction date inconsistency when BtchBookg=true.

MmbId.notes: ClrSysMmbId/MmbId format is country-specific: US ABA routing = exactly 9 digits; UK GBDSC sort code = 6 digits; DE BLZDE = 8 digits. AI cannot validate without the parent ClrSys/Cd value. CANNOT coexist with BICFI in the same FinInstnId.

TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt.notes: pacs.004 only. Must NOT exceed the original IntrBkSttlmAmt. AI cannot verify this without access to the original pacs.008/009 message. Human review required when amount is suspect.

OrgnlUETR.notes: UUID v4 referencing the original payment's UETR. Must exactly match the UETR of the original message. AI cannot verify cross-message UETR existence — human must confirm the original was sent.

MndtId.notes: pain.008 direct debit mandate ID. Must reference a pre-agreed mandate between creditor and debtor. AI CANNOT generate a valid mandate ID — it must come from the creditor's mandate registry.

DtOfSgntr.notes: Date the direct debit mandate was signed. Must be in the past. AI can ensure format is valid (YYYY-MM-DD, past date) but cannot verify the mandate actually exists.

PhoneNumber.notes: Telephone/mobile/fax numbers must start with + country code, dash, then digits/symbols. Example: +44-2071234567

HexBinaryText.notes: Used for ILPV4 cryptographic keys. Only hexadecimal characters allowed.

SHA256SignatureText.notes: Base64-encoded SHA-256 signature for PmtSgntr/Sgntr element in pacs.008/009.

UUIDv4Identifier.notes: UUID v4 format. Used for UETR and OrgnlUETR. Must always be freshly generated — never reuse.

Exact4AlphaNumericText.notes: Exactly 4 alphanumeric characters. Used for GenericIdentification30/Id (AddressType proprietary codes).

Exact2NumericText.notes: Exactly 2 numeric digits. Used in FrequencyAndMoment1/PtInTm and MandateRelatedInformation/TrckgDays.

Max10KBinary.notes: Base64-encoded binary up to 10 KB. Used for electronic signatures in mandate/payment signature fields.

ActiveCurrencyAndAmount.notes: Amount with mandatory Ccy attribute. Currency must be active (not historic). Used for IntrBkSttlmAmt.

ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount.notes: Amount with mandatory Ccy attribute. Currency may be historic. Used for InstdAmt, ChrgsInf/Amt.

BaseOneRate.notes: Exchange rate with up to 10 decimal places, total digits 11. Used for XchgRate and PreAgrdXchgRate.

DecimalNumber.notes: High-precision decimal for control sums and counts.

Max15NumericText.notes: 1 to 15 numeric digits. Used for NbOfTxs, DtldNbOfTxs.

OrgnlMsgNmId.notes: Original message name identifier in status/return/cancellation messages. Must exactly match the MsgDefIdr of the original payment.

StsId.notes: Optional status identifier in pacs.002 TxInfAndSts. Used to uniquely identify this status entry.

CxlId.notes: Cancellation ID within camt.056 TxInf block.

AssgnmtId.notes: Assignment identifier in camt.055/056. Must be unique. AI can generate a dated reference.

date_fix_rules._doc: Rules specifically for fixing date and datetime errors. The AI MUST follow these when encountering any date-related error code.

PAST_DATE_ERROR.description: A date or datetime field contains a value in the past.
PAST_DATE_ERROR.fix_action: Replace the past date/datetime with today's date (for Date fields) or now with timezone offset (for DateTime fields).
PAST_DATE_ERROR.fix_format_date: YYYY-MM-DD using today's actual calendar date
PAST_DATE_ERROR.fix_format_datetime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 using current UTC time with +00:00 offset
critical_notes: NEVER use 'Z' as timezone suffix — use '+00:00' instead (CBPR+ requirement)
NEVER include milliseconds (.sss) in the datetime
For Date-only fields (IntrBkSttlmDt, SttlmDt), use YYYY-MM-DD only
CreDtTm may be updated to 'now' if it is in the past
IntrBkSttlmDt is typically today or T+1; use today's date as minimum

FUTURE_DATE_BIRTH_ERROR.description: BirthDt is in the future, which is impossible.
FUTURE_DATE_BIRTH_ERROR.fix_action: Replace BirthDt with a valid past date.
FUTURE_DATE_BIRTH_ERROR.fix_format_date: YYYY-MM-DD — use a plausible birth date like 1990-01-15

CBPR_DATETIME_Z_FORBIDDEN.description: CBPR+ forbids the 'Z' UTC suffix. An explicit offset like +00:00 must be used.
CBPR_DATETIME_Z_FORBIDDEN.fix_action: Replace the trailing 'Z' with '+00:00'. Do NOT change the date or time part.

CBPR_DATETIME_MILLISECONDS.description: CBPR+ forbids milliseconds in datetime fields.
CBPR_DATETIME_MILLISECONDS.fix_action: Remove the .sss fractional seconds part. Keep the rest unchanged.

CBPR_DATETIME_NO_TIMEZONE.description: CBPR+ requires a timezone offset on all datetime fields.
CBPR_DATETIME_NO_TIMEZONE.fix_action: Append '+00:00' to a datetime that has no timezone suffix.

error_code_catalogue._doc: Maps every known validator error code to: root cause, affected tags, and the exact fix recipe. AI must check this FIRST when selecting a fix strategy.

PAST_DATE_ERROR.root_cause: Date/datetime field contains a date before today.
PAST_DATE_ERROR.fix: Replace value with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or now with offset (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00).
PAST_DATE_ERROR.do_not: Do NOT use 'Z', do NOT add milliseconds, do NOT invent a future date without basis.

FUTURE_DATE_BIRTH_ERROR.fix: Replace with a plausible past date: 1990-01-15.

CBPR_DATETIME_Z_FORBIDDEN.root_cause: CBPR+ forbids 'Z' suffix on datetime fields.

ID_LENGTH_ERROR.root_cause: An ID field (MsgId, EndToEndId, InstrId, TxId, BizMsgIdr, ClrSysRef) exceeds 35 characters.
ID_LENGTH_ERROR.fix: Truncate the value to 35 characters maximum. Preserve meaningful prefix if possible.

UETR_FORMAT_ERROR.root_cause: UETR is not a valid UUID v4.
UETR_FORMAT_ERROR.fix: Replace with a valid UUID v4: lowercase hex, format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx where y is 8, 9, a, or b.

BICFI_EXCLUSIVE.root_cause: CBPR+ rule: if BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, Nm and PstlAdr must NOT also be present.
BICFI_EXCLUSIVE.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr siblings from the same FinInstnId block.

MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD.root_cause: A mandatory field required by the XSD schema is absent.
MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD.fix: Insert the missing tag using the tag_templates section of this knowledge base. Always insert in XSD element order (see tag_insertion_order).

BIZMSGIDR_EQ_GRPHDR_MSGID.fix: Determine which value is correct: (1) If GrpHdr/MsgId has invalid CBPR+ characters (anything outside A-Za-z0-9 /\-?:().,'+) AND stripping those characters gives the clean BizMsgIdr value, then fix GrpHdr/MsgId by removing the invalid characters — do NOT change BizMsgIdr. (2) If BizMsgIdr is genuinely wrong (e.g. was not set from MsgId), set BizMsgIdr to the cleaned MsgId value. Never propagate dirty/invalid chars from MsgId into BizMsgIdr. Do NOT insert a new AppHdr block — the AppHdr already exists; only the mismatched field value needs correction.
BIZMSGIDR_EQ_GRPHDR_MSGID.fix_direction_rule: Prefer fixing GrpHdr/MsgId when it contains invalid chars; prefer fixing AppHdr/BizMsgIdr only when it is the genuinely incorrect value. Always use the clean/canonical value.
BIZMSGIDR_EQ_GRPHDR_MSGID.anti_pattern: Do NOT set BizMsgIdr to a value that contains invalid characters (e.g. @#!). Do NOT add a new <AppHdr> block when one already exists.

MSGDEFIDR_MISMATCH.root_cause: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document namespace.
MSGDEFIDR_MISMATCH.fix: Read the namespace URI from the Document root element and set MsgDefIdr to the message identifier portion (e.g., pacs.008.001.08).

APPHDR_FR_NEQ_INSTGAGT.root_cause: AppHdr/Fr BICFI does not match the InstgAgt BICFI in the transaction.
APPHDR_FR_NEQ_INSTGAGT.fix: Read InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from the transaction block and update AppHdr/Fr/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to match.

APPHDR_TO_NEQ_INSTDAGT.root_cause: AppHdr/To BICFI does not match the InstdAgt BICFI in the transaction.
APPHDR_TO_NEQ_INSTDAGT.fix: Read InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from the transaction block and update AppHdr/To/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to match.

APPHDR_FR_TO_DELETED_FIID_ORPHANED.root_cause: The <Fr> or <To> opening tag was deleted, leaving <FIId> as a direct child of AppHdr. AppHdr-level tags (BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt) that followed inside the same block get absorbed inside <FIId> as siblings of <FinInstnId>, because the missing </Fr> was their structural boundary. Additionally, <Document> may end up nested inside <AppHdr> when <To> is also missing. The XML parses cleanly (no well-formedness error) but fails XSD validation.
APPHDR_FR_TO_DELETED_FIID_ORPHANED.fix: Three-step structural repair: (1) Find any bare <FIId> that is a direct child of AppHdr. Re-wrap it in <Fr> (or <To> if Fr already exists). (2) Extract any AppHdr-level tags (BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt) that were wrongly absorbed inside <FIId> and move them back as AppHdr siblings after the <Fr>/<To> wrapper. (3) If <Document> is nested inside <AppHdr>, move it out to be a sibling of AppHdr under BusMsgEnvlp.
APPHDR_FR_TO_DELETED_FIID_ORPHANED.detection: XSD errors: 'Element FIId is not expected' under AppHdr, or 'Element BizMsgIdr is not expected' under FIId, or 'Element Document is not expected' under AppHdr.
APPHDR_FR_TO_DELETED_FIID_ORPHANED.applies_to: all CBPR+ message types: any message where the user deletes <Fr> or <To> from AppHdr
examples: AppHdr with Document nested inside  →  Document moved to BusMsgEnvlp sibling level

APPHDR_FR_TO_CONTENT_DELETED.root_cause: The entire content of <Fr> or <To> was deleted (both opening tags AND the inner <FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI> content), leaving only orphaned closing tags (</FIId></Fr> or </FinInstnId></FIId></To>). The document is not well-formed. After _balance_xml_tags re-inserts the missing opening tags, the Fr/To blocks exist structurally but contain empty <FIId></FIId> or <FinInstnId></FinInstnId> with no BICFI.
APPHDR_FR_TO_CONTENT_DELETED.fix: Two-pass repair: (1) _balance_xml_tags re-inserts missing opening tags from orphaned closes to restore well-formedness. (2) _normalize_busmsgenvlp Problem 4 then walks every Fr/To block and ensures FIId > FinInstnId > BICFI exists with a dummy BIC (DEUTDEFFXXX for Fr, CHASUS33XXX for To). Missing intermediate elements (FIId, FinInstnId) are created if absent.
APPHDR_FR_TO_CONTENT_DELETED.detection: lxml well-formedness error: 'Opening and ending tag mismatch' for Fr, FIId, or FinInstnId. After balance fix: XSD error 'Element FinInstnId is empty' or 'BICFI is missing'.
APPHDR_FR_TO_CONTENT_DELETED.applies_to: all CBPR+ message types with BusMsgEnvlp AppHdr

WF_STRAY_CLOSING_TAG.root_cause: One or more closing tags appear in the XML but their matching opening tags were deleted. lxml emits 'Opening and ending tag mismatch: X and Y'. The document cannot be parsed until the missing opening tags are re-inserted. Common cases: <Fr> missing <FIId> wrapper, <DbtrAcct> opening deleted, any structural wrapper element whose open tag was removed while the close tag remained.
WF_STRAY_CLOSING_TAG.fix: Full tag-balance scan: tokenise the entire raw XML, walk every tag token maintaining an open-tag stack, detect every orphaned closing tag (no matching open on the stack), then insert the missing opening tag at the correct position. Also inserts synthetic closes for any elements still open when a parent closes over them (e.g. </PmtId> while <UETR> is open). This repairs ALL missing opening and closing tags in one pass.
WF_STRAY_CLOSING_TAG.detection: lxml emits: 'Opening and ending tag mismatch: <parent> line N and <missing_tag>' — but the engine scans the whole document proactively so it also catches cases where lxml recovery would silently truncate content.
WF_STRAY_CLOSING_TAG.applies_to: all message types and ALL structural elements universally: Fr/FIId, To/FIId, DbtrAgt/FinInstnId, CdtrAgt/FinInstnId, DbtrAcct, CdtrAcct, GrpHdr, CdtTrfTxInf, PmtId, UETR, and any other element whose opening or closing tag was removed

WF_APPHDR_STRAY_TEXT_BICFI.root_cause: The Fr block opening tags (<Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>) were deleted but the BICFI text value leaked into the AppHdr raw text area, leaving a pattern like '\n\t\tBNPPGB2LXXX</BICFI>' before the <To> element. Also covers <To> blocks where FIId/FinInstnId wrappers were deleted, leaving <BICFI> as a direct child of <To>.
WF_APPHDR_STRAY_TEXT_BICFI.fix: Stage 2.2 (_strip_empty_apphdr_frto_closes) detects stray text + orphaned </BICFI> before the first legitimate AppHdr open tag and strips the entire garbage region. It also strips the inner content of any <Fr>/<To> that contains a direct <BICFI> child (missing FIId/FinInstnId). _normalize_busmsgenvlp Problem 4 then rebuilds the full Fr/To/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI chain from scratch.
WF_APPHDR_STRAY_TEXT_BICFI.detection: lxml: 'Opening and ending tag mismatch: AppHdr and BICFI' or similar. AppHdr area has raw text (BIC value) before the first opening tag.
WF_APPHDR_STRAY_TEXT_BICFI.applies_to: all CBPR+ message types with BusMsgEnvlp AppHdr — pain.001, pacs.008, camt.055, etc.
examples: AppHdr>\n\t\tBNPPGB2LXXX</BICFI>\n<To>...  →  stripped; Fr rebuilt with DEUTDEFFXXX

WF_UNCLOSED_OPEN_TAG.root_cause: An opening tag is present in the XML but its closing tag was deleted. The parent element closes over it, causing lxml 'Opening and ending tag mismatch'. Common case: <UETR>uuid\n\t\t</PmtId> — </UETR> deleted, so </PmtId> closes PmtId while UETR is still open.
WF_UNCLOSED_OPEN_TAG.fix: The balance engine detects elements being 'auto-popped' off the stack when a parent closes (depth > matched depth). For each such element a synthetic </Tag> is inserted immediately before the closing parent tag. This restores the correct nesting without altering content.
WF_UNCLOSED_OPEN_TAG.detection: lxml: 'Opening and ending tag mismatch: UETR line N and PmtId'. Any case where a leaf element's closing tag is deleted and the parent closes first.
WF_UNCLOSED_OPEN_TAG.applies_to: all message types — any leaf or container element whose closing tag was deleted: UETR, InstrId, EndToEndId, IBAN, Nm, any text-content element

WF_STRAY_CHAR_IN_TAG.root_cause: An illegal character (e.g. '!', '@', '#') appears inside an XML opening or closing tag — after the last attribute value but before the closing '>' or '/>' of that tag. Example: '<BusMsgEnvlp xmlns="urn:swift:xsd:envelope"!>' has '!' before '>'. This makes the document non-well-formed and prevents parsing.
WF_STRAY_CHAR_IN_TAG.fix: Remove every character that is not whitespace, '/', or '>' from the gap between the last attribute quote and the tag's closing '>'. Applies to EVERY tag in the document — BusMsgEnvlp, AppHdr, Document, and all others. The fix must operate on the raw XML text, not the parsed tree (the document cannot be parsed until this is fixed).
WF_STRAY_CHAR_IN_TAG.regex_pattern: Strip characters matching [^\s/>] found after the last attribute quote ('"' or "'") and before the first '>' or '/>' of each opening/closing tag.
WF_STRAY_CHAR_IN_TAG.applies_to: all message types and all tags universally

APPHDR_FR_MISSING.root_cause: AppHdr/Fr is completely absent. Fr is CBPR+ mandatory in the BAH (head.001) AppHdr for ALL CBPR+ message types. This rule applies universally: pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, pacs.003, pacs.004, pacs.010, pain.001, pain.002, pain.008, camt.052, camt.053, camt.054, camt.055, camt.056, camt.057. This is NOT a value mismatch — the whole element was deleted, so there is nothing to update; the AI must INSERT it.
APPHDR_FR_MISSING.fix: Insert a full Fr element as the FIRST child of AppHdr using tag_templates.Fr. Harvest $INSTG_BICFI in this priority order: (1) InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from any transaction block (CdtTrfTxInf, DrctDbtTxInf, TxInf, CdtInstr), (2) Assgnr/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI for camt.055/056, (3) GrpHdr/InstgAgt for pacs.002/004, (4) any BICFI already present in the document, (5) dummy_data.parties.instructing_agent.bicfi (BARCGB22XXX) as last resort.
APPHDR_FR_MISSING.insert_position: First child of AppHdr, before To (see tag_insertion_order.AppHdr).
APPHDR_FR_MISSING.must_equal: The inserted Fr BICFI MUST equal InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI when InstgAgt is present.
APPHDR_FR_MISSING.do_not: Do NOT add Nm or PstlAdr inside Fr/FIId/FinInstnId when BICFI is present (BICFI_EXCLUSIVE). Do NOT skip this fix for non-pacs.008 messages — it applies to ALL CBPR+ message types.

APPHDR_TO_MISSING.root_cause: AppHdr/To is completely absent. To is CBPR+ mandatory in the BAH (head.001) AppHdr for ALL CBPR+ message types. This rule applies universally: pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, pacs.003, pacs.004, pacs.010, pain.001, pain.002, pain.008, camt.052, camt.053, camt.054, camt.055, camt.056, camt.057. This is NOT a value mismatch — the whole element was deleted, so there is nothing to update; the AI must INSERT it.
APPHDR_TO_MISSING.fix: Insert a full To element into AppHdr immediately AFTER Fr using tag_templates.To. Harvest $INSTD_BICFI in this priority order: (1) InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from any transaction block, (2) Assgne/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI for camt.055/056, (3) GrpHdr/InstdAgt for pacs.002/004, (4) any other BICFI in the document, (5) dummy_data.parties.instructed_agent.bicfi (CHASUS33XXX) as last resort.
APPHDR_TO_MISSING.insert_position: Second child of AppHdr, immediately after Fr and before BizMsgIdr (see tag_insertion_order.AppHdr).
APPHDR_TO_MISSING.must_equal: The inserted To BICFI MUST equal InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI when InstdAgt is present.
APPHDR_TO_MISSING.do_not: Do NOT add Nm or PstlAdr inside To/FIId/FinInstnId when BICFI is present (BICFI_EXCLUSIVE). Do NOT skip this fix for non-pacs.008 messages — it applies to ALL CBPR+ message types.

NBOFTXS_MISMATCH.root_cause: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual number of transaction blocks.
NBOFTXS_MISMATCH.fix: Count all CdtTrfTxInf (or DrctDbtTxInf or TxInfAndSts) elements and set NbOfTxs to that count.

EMPTY_CDTDBTIND.root_cause: CdtDbtInd element is present but empty or whitespace-only. CreditDebitCode only accepts 'CRDT' (credit) or 'DBIT' (debit) — empty string is invalid. Occurs in camt statement entries (Ntry), transaction details (TxDtls), and balance (Bal) elements when the user deletes the value.
EMPTY_CDTDBTIND.fix: Set CdtDbtInd to 'CRDT' or 'DBIT'. Inference priority: (1) if another CdtDbtInd sibling within the same parent has a valid value, borrow it; (2) default to 'CRDT' (credit entry) when no context is available. CRDT means money received/credited; DBIT means money sent/debited.
EMPTY_CDTDBTIND.applies_to: camt.052, camt.053, camt.054, and any camt message containing Ntry, TxDtls, or Bal elements

EMPTY_NBOFNTRIES.root_cause: NbOfNtries element is present but empty or whitespace-only. Occurs in camt.052/053/054 when the user manually deleted the entry count value. XSD type is Max15NumericText ([0-9]{1,15}) — empty string is invalid.
EMPTY_NBOFNTRIES.fix: Count the number of <Ntry> elements in the entire document and set NbOfNtries to that count. If no Ntry elements exist, set to '0'. Do NOT delete the element — it is required to be non-empty when present.

EMPTY_PGINFO.root_cause: StmtPgntn/PgNb or StmtPgntn/LastPgInd is empty. Both are mandatory children of StmtPgntn in camt.052/053/054. PgNb type is Max5NumericText ([0-9]{1,5}); LastPgInd is YesNoIndicator (must be 'true' or 'false').
EMPTY_PGINFO.fix: For PgNb: set to '1' (first page) if empty. For LastPgInd: set to 'true' (single-page statement) if empty. Both must be non-empty when StmtPgntn is present.

EMPTY_ASSGNMT_ID.root_cause: The <Id> element inside <Assgnmt> is empty or self-closing (<Id/>). Assgnmt/Id is a mandatory Max35Text field that uniquely identifies the assignment in camt.055 and other camt cancellation/assignment messages.
EMPTY_ASSGNMT_ID.fix: Generate a non-empty identifier string (Max35Text, up to 35 characters, e.g. 'ASSGN-001' or a UUID-style string). The value only needs to be locally unique; any non-empty alphanumeric string satisfies the constraint.
EMPTY_ASSGNMT_ID.applies_to: camt.055, camt.029, camt.028, camt.056 — any message with Assgnmt/Id

EMPTY_CXLRSN_CD.root_cause: The <Cd> element inside <CxlRsnInf><Rsn> is empty or self-closing (<Cd/>). This is a cancellation reason code from the ExternalCancellationReason1Code codelist, required when the Rsn element uses the Cd variant.
EMPTY_CXLRSN_CD.fix: Set to a valid ExternalCancellationReason1Code. Common values: DUPL (duplicate), CUST (customer request), NARR (narrative/other), FRAD (fraudulent origin), CNCL (cancellation requested). Default: DUPL.
EMPTY_CXLRSN_CD.applies_to: camt.055, camt.056, pacs.007, pacs.004 — any CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Cd field

IBAN_INVALID.root_cause: IBAN fails checksum or format validation.
IBAN_INVALID.fix: Replace with a valid IBAN from dummy_data.ibans for the party's country. If country unknown, use dummy_data.ibans.default.

INVALID_BICFI.root_cause: BIC code is not in the known BIC registry or fails format validation.
INVALID_BICFI.fix: Replace with a valid BIC from dummy_data.banks. If country is known, prefer a bank from that country.

CHRGBR_INVALID.root_cause: ChrgBr value is not in allowed codelist.

CHRGSINF_CCY_MISMATCH.root_cause: ChrgsInf/Amt currency does not match IntrBkSttlmAmt currency. Charges must always be expressed in the same currency as the interbank settlement amount.
CHRGSINF_CCY_MISMATCH.fix: Update ChrgsInf/Amt/@Ccy to match IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy. Example: If IntrBkSttlmAmt has Ccy='SEK' but ChrgsInf/Amt has Ccy='USD', change the Ccy attribute in ChrgsInf/Amt to 'SEK'.

XCHGRATE_REQUIRED.root_cause: InstdAmt currency differs from IntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is absent. This applies to both PACS.008 (credit transfers) and PACS.003 (direct debits).
XCHGRATE_REQUIRED.fix: Insert <XchgRate>1.0</XchgRate> inside the transaction block (CdtTrfTxInf for pacs.008 or DrctDbtTxInf for pacs.003), after InstdAmt. Use the actual exchange rate value (e.g., 1.1234) with up to 10 decimal places. If the currencies are actually the same, remove InstdAmt entirely instead.

XCHGRATE_FORBIDDEN.root_cause: InstdAmt currency equals IntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is present.

EMPTY_FININSTNID.root_cause: A FinInstnId element is present but completely empty (no BICFI, no Nm, no ClrSysMmbId).
EMPTY_FININSTNID.fix: Add a BICFI child element inside FinInstnId using an appropriate BIC from dummy_data.banks.

MISSING_UETR.root_cause: UETR is required under CBPR+ for pacs.008 and pacs.009 but is absent.

SANCTIONS_BLOCKED.root_cause: A party field contains a sanctioned country code or name.
SANCTIONS_BLOCKED.fix: Replace the sanctioned country (Ctry), BIC, or name with non-sanctioned dummy values from dummy_data.

DUPLICATE_MSGID.root_cause: MsgId already exists in the system.
DUPLICATE_MSGID.fix: Generate a new unique MsgId by appending current date and a counter, e.g. MSG-20260528-002.

PACS008_MISSING_FWDGAGT.root_cause: pain.008 requires FwdgAgt in GrpHdr under SWIFT CBPR+ MyStandards.
PACS008_MISSING_FWDGAGT.fix: Insert FwdgAgt block inside GrpHdr using template from tag_templates.FwdgAgt.

INVALID_CHARSETS.root_cause: A text field contains characters outside the allowed SWIFT character set.
INVALID_CHARSETS.fix: Remove or replace invalid characters. Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + SPACE. Replace special/accented chars with ASCII equivalents.

PSTLADR_MISSING_CTRY.root_cause: PstlAdr is present but Ctry is missing.
PSTLADR_MISSING_CTRY.fix: Add <Ctry>GB</Ctry> inside PstlAdr (or use the party's known country).

PSTLADR_MISSING_TWNNM.root_cause: PstlAdr uses structured form (no AdrLine) but TwnNm is missing.
PSTLADR_MISSING_TWNNM.fix: Add <TwnNm>London</TwnNm> inside PstlAdr (or use the party's known city).

SCHEMENAME_INVALID.root_cause: SchmeNm/Cd is not in the allowed codelist for the identifier type.
SCHEMENAME_INVALID.fix: Replace with an appropriate code: for OrgId use CUST, BANK, or TXID; for PrvtId use NIDN, DRLC, or ARNU.

DUPLICATE_TAG.root_cause: A tag appears more times than the XSD max occurrence allows.
DUPLICATE_TAG.fix: Remove the duplicate occurrence(s), keeping only one instance.

CTRL_SUM_MISMATCH.root_cause: CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all transaction amounts.
CTRL_SUM_MISMATCH.fix: Sum all IntrBkSttlmAmt (or InstdAmt) values and update CtrlSum to that total.

MISSING_EXPECTED_ELEMENT.root_cause: An element is missing that the XSD expects. The error will say 'One of the following elements is expected: [Tag]' or 'This element is not expected. Expected is...'.
MISSING_EXPECTED_ELEMENT.fix: Extract the missing tag name from the error message and insert it into the parent element using the tag_templates section. Always insert in XSD element order (see tag_insertion_order).

IBAN_COUNTRY_BIC_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.root_cause: IBAN country prefix (chars 1–2) does not match the BIC country code (chars 5–6) of the corresponding DbtrAgt or CdtrAgt. Example: IBAN DE89… with CdtrAgt CHASUS33XXX (US bank).
IBAN_COUNTRY_BIC_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. AI cannot determine which is authoritative — the IBAN or the BIC — without business context. The operator must verify the beneficiary bank details. Replace the mismatched party with consistent IBAN+BIC from the same country.
IBAN_COUNTRY_BIC_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.ai_cannot_fix_reason: No deterministic way to choose between correcting the IBAN country or the BIC country without original transaction context.

CORRESPONDENT_ROUTING_LOOP.root_cause: IntrmyAgt1, IntrmyAgt2, or IntrmyAgt3 BICFI equals InstgAgt or InstdAgt BICFI, creating a circular routing chain.
CORRESPONDENT_ROUTING_LOOP.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Remove or replace the redundant intermediary agent. AI cannot determine the correct correspondent banking chain without payment routing knowledge.
CORRESPONDENT_ROUTING_LOOP.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Correct correspondent chain depends on bilateral agreements and payment routing rules unknown to AI.

CLRSYSMMBID_FORMAT.root_cause: ClrSysMmbId/MmbId format is invalid for the declared clearing system. Format rules: US ABA (USABA) = exactly 9 digits; UK sort code (GBDSC) = exactly 6 digits; DE bank code (BLZDE) = exactly 8 digits.
CLRSYSMMBID_FORMAT.fix: Identify the ClrSys/Cd value in the parent FinInstnId. Then apply the correct format: USABA → 9 digits, GBDSC → 6 digits, BLZDE → 8 digits. If ClrSys/Cd is missing, add it before fixing MmbId.
CLRSYSMMBID_FORMAT.do_not: Do NOT use a BICFI dummy when ClrSysMmbId is intentionally used (e.g., for domestic ACH routing).

CLRSYSMMBID_BICFI_COEXIST.root_cause: BICFI and ClrSysMmbId are both present inside the same FinInstnId. ISO 20022 XSD and CBPR+ require use of only ONE identification method.
CLRSYSMMBID_BICFI_COEXIST.fix: Remove ClrSysMmbId (and its parent ClrSys block) when BICFI is present, as BICFI is the preferred CBPR+ identifier. Alternatively remove BICFI if the message is a domestic payment using clearing system identification.
CLRSYSMMBID_BICFI_COEXIST.do_not: Do NOT keep both — XSD schema will reject the message.

BTCHBOOKG_STTLMDT_MISMATCH.root_cause: BtchBookg=true is set in GrpHdr but CdtTrfTxInf blocks have different IntrBkSttlmDt values. When batch booking is active, all transactions must settle on the same date.
BTCHBOOKG_STTLMDT_MISMATCH.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Determine the intended settlement date (earliest or latest) from the operator. Then update all IntrBkSttlmDt values to the same date. AI cannot determine the correct date without business intent.
BTCHBOOKG_STTLMDT_MISMATCH.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Cannot determine if the batch should settle earliest, latest, or a specific date without operator instruction.

PACS009_COVE_MISSING_UNDERLYING.root_cause: pacs.009 has SttlmMtd=COVE but the required UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf block is absent. CBPR+ COV variant mandates a complete underlying customer credit transfer.
PACS009_COVE_MISSING_UNDERLYING.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. AI cannot generate a valid UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf block from scratch — it requires the original customer payment details (Dbtr, Cdtr, amounts, RemittanceInfo) that only the originating bank knows. The operator must supply the underlying customer payment data.
PACS009_COVE_MISSING_UNDERLYING.ai_cannot_fix_reason: UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf content (debtor/creditor names, accounts, remittance) is business data that cannot be invented by AI.

RETURN_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL.root_cause: pacs.004 TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt exceeds the IntrBkSttlmAmt of the original payment. A return cannot exceed the original transaction amount.
RETURN_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Obtain the original IntrBkSttlmAmt from the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 message. Set TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt to a value ≤ the original amount (minus applicable charges if partial return).
RETURN_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL.ai_cannot_fix_reason: AI has no access to the original message to determine the maximum allowable return amount.

ORGNL_MSG_UNRESOLVABLE.root_cause: OrgnlMsgId, OrgnlEndToEndId, or OrgnlUETR in a return/cancellation/status message does not reference a known original message. The originator system cannot match the payment.
ORGNL_MSG_UNRESOLVABLE.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Verify the OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlUETR by looking up the original payment in the bank's payment tracking system. AI cannot cross-reference messages across sessions.
ORGNL_MSG_UNRESOLVABLE.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Cross-message reference validation requires access to a payment ledger or message archive — not available to AI.

MANDATE_INFO_MISSING.root_cause: pain.008 DrctDbtTx/MndtRltdInf is absent or invalid. Direct debit mandates require MndtId (pre-assigned mandate reference) and DtOfSgntr (date mandate was signed). These cannot be invented.
MANDATE_INFO_MISSING.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. The MndtId must come from the creditor's mandate management system. AI cannot generate a valid mandate reference. Contact the creditor to obtain the correct MndtId and DtOfSgntr.
MANDATE_INFO_MISSING.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Mandate data is externally assigned by the creditor; AI has no access to mandate registry.

STTLMTMINDCTN_EXCLUSIVE.root_cause: SttlmTmIndctn contains both CdtDtTm and DbtDtTm, or neither. Exactly one must be present. CdtDtTm applies to the credit leg; DbtDtTm applies to the debit leg.
STTLMTMINDCTN_EXCLUSIVE.fix: Determine from context which leg the timing applies to. For pacs.008 (credit transfer), use CdtDtTm. For pacs.003 (direct debit), use DbtDtTm. Remove the incorrect element. If both are absent, insert the appropriate one using the settlement time from CLS window rules.
STTLMTMINDCTN_EXCLUSIVE.do_not: Do NOT include both CdtDtTm and DbtDtTm in the same SttlmTmIndctn block.

PACS010_NBTXS_WRONG_LEVEL.root_cause: pacs.010 NbOfTxs in GrpHdr counts the number of CdtInstr blocks, NOT the total DrctDbtTxInf elements across all CdtInstr blocks. Miscounting is a common error in bulk pacs.010 generation.
PACS010_NBTXS_WRONG_LEVEL.fix: Count only the CdtInstr elements directly under FIDrctDbt. Set NbOfTxs to that count. Do NOT count the DrctDbtTxInf inside each CdtInstr.

RMTINF_STRD_USTRD_BOTH.root_cause: RmtInf contains both Strd (structured) and Ustrd (unstructured) remittance blocks. XSD allows one or the other, not both.
RMTINF_STRD_USTRD_BOTH.fix: Remove Ustrd if Strd is present (structured data is preferred). Remove Strd if only free-text remittance is available. Never keep both.
RMTINF_STRD_USTRD_BOTH.do_not: Do NOT keep both Strd and Ustrd — most receiving banks will reject or truncate the message.
RMTINF_STRD_USTRD_BOTH.preferred: Strd when a reference number is available; Ustrd for free-text invoice descriptions.

CAMT05X_BALANCE_MISMATCH.root_cause: In camt.052/053/054, the sum of Ntry amounts does not reconcile with the difference between opening and closing Balance values. Indicates missing entries or wrong amounts.
CAMT05X_BALANCE_MISMATCH.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Recalculate the expected balance: closing balance = opening balance ± sum of all credited/debited Ntry amounts. AI cannot know the correct account balance without external account data.
CAMT05X_BALANCE_MISMATCH.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Correct balance reconciliation requires access to the bank's account ledger.

SEPA_REACHABILITY_VIOLATION.root_cause: The creditor's IBAN country code is not a SEPA reachability country (e.g., US, IN, SG, CN, JP, AU). SEPA payments require both debtor and creditor IBANs to be from SEPA member countries.
SEPA_REACHABILITY_VIOLATION.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. If the payment is genuinely cross-border (non-SEPA), change the message type from pain.001 SEPA to pacs.008 cross-border. If it should be SEPA, correct the creditor IBAN to a valid SEPA country IBAN.
SEPA_REACHABILITY_VIOLATION.ai_cannot_fix_reason: AI cannot change the payment type or generate a valid SEPA IBAN for a non-SEPA beneficiary.

DUPLICATE_UETR_CROSS_BATCH.root_cause: Two or more messages in the same bulk generation batch share the same UETR value. UETR must be globally unique per SWIFT transaction.
DUPLICATE_UETR_CROSS_BATCH.fix: For each duplicate, generate a new UUID v4. The auto-fixer handles one message at a time and cannot detect cross-message UETR collisions in a batch. Validate the full batch output for UETR uniqueness after generation.
DUPLICATE_UETR_CROSS_BATCH.do_not: Do NOT copy the UETR from one message to another. Each transaction must have its own freshly generated UUID v4.

XCHGRATE_PRECISION_INSUFFICIENT.root_cause: XchgRate value has insufficient decimal precision. Forex rates typically require 5–6 decimal places (e.g., 1.23456). A value of '1.0' is accepted by XSD but will be rejected by many bank systems as imprecise.
XCHGRATE_PRECISION_INSUFFICIENT.fix: Use a realistic exchange rate with at least 4 decimal places. For testing use '1.0000'. For actual FX transactions, the exchange rate must come from the payment originator's FX system — AI cannot supply a real market rate.
XCHGRATE_PRECISION_INSUFFICIENT.do_not: Do NOT use '1.0' for cross-currency transactions sent to production systems.

PACS002_REJECTION_CODE_SEMANTIC.root_cause: TxSts=RJCT is present but StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd (e.g., AC01=account closed) does not semantically match the actual rejection reason. Using a dummy code in production causes downstream confusion.
PACS002_REJECTION_CODE_SEMANTIC.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED for production messages. For testing, AC01 is acceptable. For production: consult the actual rejection notification from the receiving bank and use the correct ISO 20022 reason code. Common codes: AC01 (closed), AC04 (invalid account), AM04 (insufficient funds), BE01 (party mismatch), LEGL (legal decision).
PACS002_REJECTION_CODE_SEMANTIC.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Correct rejection reason code is specific to the actual failure — AI cannot know why the payment was really rejected.

MT_FIELD72_AMBIGUOUS_NARRATIVE.root_cause: MT field 72 contains multiple mixed /code/ lines (e.g., /BNF/, /ACC/, /INS/, /RFB/, /ROC/) that cannot be unambiguously mapped to a single MX element. The conversion engine must interpret intent.
MT_FIELD72_AMBIGUOUS_NARRATIVE.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED for MT→MX conversion. Map each /code/ as follows: /BNF/ → InstrForCdtrAgt/InstrInf (beneficiary instruction); /ACC/ → CdtrAcct/Id/Othr; /INS/ → IntrmyAgt1; /RFB/ → RmtInf/Strd/CdtrRefInf; /ROC/ → GrpHdr reference. When ambiguous, place content in RmtInf/Ustrd and flag for review.
MT_FIELD72_AMBIGUOUS_NARRATIVE.ai_cannot_fix_reason: MT field 72 is a free-format narrative field; correct MX mapping depends on the sending bank's conventions.

SANCTIONS_REAL_TIME_CHECK.root_cause: A party (Dbtr, Cdtr, intermediary) may appear on OFAC/EU/UN/HMT sanctions lists that are updated daily. Static BIC-based check is insufficient for production compliance.
SANCTIONS_REAL_TIME_CHECK.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED for production. The validator's static BIC list check is for testing only. Before processing any live payment, run parties through your institution's real-time sanctions screening system (e.g., Fircosoft, Oracle FCCM, NICE Actimize).
SANCTIONS_REAL_TIME_CHECK.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Sanctions lists change daily. AI has a static snapshot and cannot perform real-time lookups.

INSTRFORCDTRAGT_INCOMPATIBLE_CODES.root_cause: InstrForCdtrAgt/Cd contains instruction codes that are mutually exclusive or that contradict other message fields. Example: HOLD (hold payment) combined with PHOB (phone beneficiary) is operationally contradictory.
INSTRFORCDTRAGT_INCOMPATIBLE_CODES.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Verify the intended instruction with the originating bank. Remove contradictory instructions. Only one instruction code block per InstrForCdtrAgt element is recommended.
INSTRFORCDTRAGT_INCOMPATIBLE_CODES.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Instruction code semantics depend on the bilateral agreement between correspondent banks.

BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE.root_cause: The message is wrapped in a <BusMsgEnvlp> element with namespace 'urn:swift:xsd:envelope'. This is a SWIFT proprietary Business Message Envelope format that is NOT part of the ISO 20022 standard. ISO 20022 messages must begin with either: (a) <Document> as the root, or (b) <AppHdr> followed immediately by <Document> as two sibling root elements. The BusMsgEnvlp wrapper prevents namespace-aware XSD validation from resolving the correct ISO 20022 schema.
BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Remove the outer <BusMsgEnvlp> wrapper and restructure the message so AppHdr and Document are the top-level elements. See structural_fix_guide below.
BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Stripping BusMsgEnvlp requires understanding the full envelope structure, re-rooting namespace declarations, and correcting the Document element placement. The payload may also be structurally malformed (e.g. Document content nested inside AppHdr instead of alongside it). This is an architectural restructure, not a field-level fix.

steps: 1. Remove the opening <BusMsgEnvlp> and closing </BusMsgEnvlp> tags
2. Ensure AppHdr is a standalone root element with its own xmlns declaration
3. Move the Document payload (e.g. <CstmrDrctDbtInitn>) OUT of AppHdr and into its own <Document> element
4. Set Document xmlns to match the correct message type namespace (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.008.001.08)
5. Ensure AppHdr contains the mandatory CBPR+ fields: Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt
structural_fix_guide.known_pitfall: When CstmrDrctDbtInitn (or any message root) is nested inside AppHdr, it is invisible to the XSD validator and produces misleading 'element not expected' errors on the AppHdr children. The fix is to extract it entirely into a sibling Document element.

BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE.detection_hint: Trigger this error when: (a) the XML root element local-name is 'BusMsgEnvlp', OR (b) the root namespace is 'urn:swift:xsd:envelope', OR (c) a message-specific root element (CstmrDrctDbtInitn, FIToFICstmrCdtTrf, etc.) appears as a direct child of AppHdr rather than Document.

DOCUMENT_NESTED_IN_APPHDR.root_cause: A message-specific root element (e.g. CstmrDrctDbtInitn, FIToFICstmrCdtTrf, FinInstnCdtTrf, FIToFIPmtStsRpt, CstmrCdtTrfInitn, etc.) appears as a child of AppHdr instead of being inside a standalone <Document> element. This is structurally invalid — AppHdr and Document must be siblings, not parent/child.
DOCUMENT_NESTED_IN_APPHDR.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. The message-specific root element must be extracted from AppHdr and placed inside its own <Document xmlns='urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:{msg_type}'> element that is a sibling to AppHdr.
DOCUMENT_NESTED_IN_APPHDR.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Re-rooting the Document content requires knowing the correct message type namespace, confirming all namespace declarations are transferred, and verifying no AppHdr-specific content was accidentally mixed into the Document block. This is a structural rewrite that the AI cannot perform without risk of data loss or corruption.
DOCUMENT_NESTED_IN_APPHDR.detection_hint: Trigger when any element from the message_root_elements list appears as a direct child of AppHdr.

APPHDR_MISSING_MANDATORY_CBPR_FIELDS.root_cause: AppHdr is present but missing one or more CBPR+ mandatory fields. Required AppHdr fields under CBPR+: Fr (sender BIC), To (receiver BIC), BizMsgIdr (= GrpHdr/MsgId), MsgDefIdr (= message namespace identifier), BizSvc (= swift.cbprplus.02 or .03), CreDt (datetime with +HH:MM offset).
APPHDR_MISSING_MANDATORY_CBPR_FIELDS.fix: Insert each missing mandatory field using tag_templates. BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId. MsgDefIdr must match the Document namespace. BizSvc must be swift.cbprplus.02 (SR2023/2024) or swift.cbprplus.03 (SR2025). CreDt must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format.
APPHDR_MISSING_MANDATORY_CBPR_FIELDS.notes: Fr and To can be auto-fixed by harvesting InstgAgt/InstdAgt BICFIs from the payload. BizMsgIdr can be harvested from GrpHdr/MsgId. MsgDefIdr can be derived from the Document namespace URI.

BIZSVC_WRONG_VALUE_V03.root_cause: AppHdr/BizSvc contains 'swift.cbprplus.03' which is NOT a valid CBPR+ SR2025 business service identifier. The correct value is 'swift.cbprplus.02' for all CBPR+ messages.
BIZSVC_WRONG_VALUE_V03.fix: Replace the value with 'swift.cbprplus.02'. The value .03 does not exist in SR2025 CBPR+ guidelines.
BIZSVC_WRONG_VALUE_V03.do_not: Do NOT accept swift.cbprplus.03 as valid — it is a fictitious value.

LEI_INVALID.root_cause: LEI field value does not match the ISO 17442 pattern. LEI must be 20 alphanumeric characters: 18 uppercase alphanumeric followed by 2 check digits.
LEI_INVALID.fix: Replace with a valid LEI from dummy_data.banks (e.g. 7LTWFZYICNSX8D621K86). If the actual entity LEI is unknown, this requires human review.

PHONE_FORMAT_ERROR.root_cause: PhoneNumber field does not match the required pattern: +[country_code]-[number]. Leading + and a dash separator are mandatory.
PHONE_FORMAT_ERROR.fix: Reformat to: +{country_code}-{local_number}. Example: +44-2071234567. Remove spaces and insert the dash after the country code.

IBAN_PATTERN_ERROR.root_cause: IBAN does not match the ISO 13616 structural pattern: 2-letter country code, 2 check digits, up to 30 alphanumeric characters.
IBAN_PATTERN_ERROR.fix: Replace with a valid IBAN from dummy_data.ibans for the debtor/creditor country. If the country is unknown, use dummy_data.ibans.default.

AMOUNT_NEGATIVE.root_cause: An amount field (IntrBkSttlmAmt, InstdAmt, ChrgsInf/Amt) contains a negative value. All amounts in ISO 20022 must be zero or positive (minInclusive=0).
AMOUNT_NEGATIVE.fix: Replace the negative value with its absolute value. If the credit/debit direction needs to be indicated, use the CreditDebitCode element (CRDT/DBIT) on the enclosing element rather than a negative amount.

AMOUNT_PRECISION_EXCEEDED.root_cause: Amount field has more than 5 fractional digits, violating XSD fractionDigits=5 on ActiveCurrencyAndAmount / ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount. Applies to all ISO 20022 message types: pacs.008/009/003/010, pain.001/002/008, camt.052/053/054/055/056/057.
AMOUNT_PRECISION_EXCEEDED.fix: Round the existing amount to the ISO 4217 standard precision for the currency (e.g. 2 for EUR/USD/GBP, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD), capped at 5 decimal places. Always preserve the original numeric value — round it, do NOT replace it with a dummy. Example: EUR 444911.1234567 → 444911.12. The AI fixer reads currency precision from currency.json and repairs in-place.
AMOUNT_PRECISION_EXCEEDED.do_not: Do NOT replace the amount with a dummy value (1000.00) or borrow the amount from another transaction. Always repair the existing numeric value by rounding.

PACS002_MISSING_ORGNLMSGID.root_cause: pacs.002 OrgnlGrpInfAndSts is present but OrgnlMsgId is absent. OrgnlMsgId is mandatory (minOccurs=1) inside OriginalGroupHeader.
PACS002_MISSING_ORGNLMSGID.fix: Insert <OrgnlMsgId>{original message ID}</OrgnlMsgId> as the first child of OrgnlGrpInfAndSts. Harvest from the original pacs.008/009 MsgId if available; else use dummy_data.ids.OrgnlMsgId.

PACS002_MISSING_ORGNLMSGNMID.root_cause: pacs.002 OrgnlGrpInfAndSts is present but OrgnlMsgNmId is absent. OrgnlMsgNmId is mandatory (minOccurs=1).
PACS002_MISSING_ORGNLMSGNMID.fix: Insert <OrgnlMsgNmId>pacs.008.001.08</OrgnlMsgNmId> (or the appropriate original message name) as the second child of OrgnlGrpInfAndSts.
PACS002_MISSING_ORGNLMSGNMID.notes: OrgnlMsgNmId identifies the message family of the original payment (e.g., pacs.008.001.08, pain.001.001.09).

CAMT055_ASSGNMT_MISSING.root_cause: camt.055 CustomerPaymentCancellationRequest is missing the mandatory Assgnmt block. Both Assgnmt and Undrlyg are mandatory at the top level.
CAMT055_ASSGNMT_MISSING.fix: Insert the Assgnmt block using tag_templates.Assgnmt. The Assgnmt must contain Id, Assgnr (assigner), Assgne (assignee), and CreDtTm.

PAIN001_REQD_EXCTN_DT_TYPE.root_cause: pain.001 PmtInf/ReqdExctnDt is structured incorrectly. The field is a DateAndDateTime2Choice — it requires EITHER a child <Dt> element (for an ISODate) OR a child <DtTm> element (for ISODateTime), not a bare date value directly inside ReqdExctnDt.
PAIN001_REQD_EXCTN_DT_TYPE.fix: If supplying a date-only value: wrap as <ReqdExctnDt><Dt>YYYY-MM-DD</Dt></ReqdExctnDt>. If supplying a datetime: wrap as <ReqdExctnDt><DtTm>YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM</DtTm></ReqdExctnDt>. Default to <Dt> form for simplicity.

PAIN001_PMTINF_MISSING_PMTINFID.root_cause: pain.001 PmtInf block is missing the mandatory PmtInfId element (minOccurs=1).
PAIN001_PMTINF_MISSING_PMTINFID.fix: Insert <PmtInfId>PMT-INF-{date}-001</PmtInfId> as the first child of PmtInf.

PAIN001_PMTINF_MISSING_PMTMTD.root_cause: pain.001 PmtInf/PmtMtd is missing. PmtMtd is mandatory (minOccurs=1) in PaymentInstruction. Valid values: CHK (cheque), TRF (credit transfer), TRA (transfer advice).
PAIN001_PMTINF_MISSING_PMTMTD.fix: Insert <PmtMtd>TRF</PmtMtd> as the second child of PmtInf (after PmtInfId). TRF is the standard CBPR+ credit transfer method.

PAIN001_GRPHDR_MISSING_INITGPTY.root_cause: pain.001 GrpHdr/InitgPty is missing. InitgPty (Initiating Party) is mandatory (minOccurs=1) in GroupHeader114.
PAIN001_GRPHDR_MISSING_INITGPTY.fix: Insert <InitgPty><Nm>{debtor name}</InitgPty></Nm> inside GrpHdr, after NbOfTxs/CtrlSum. Harvest debtor name from PmtInf/Dbtr/Nm if present.

PACS009_COVE_UNDERLYING_INCOMPLETE.root_cause: pacs.009 COV (COVE settlement method) UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf block exists but is missing mandatory fields: Dbtr (mandatory), DbtrAgt (mandatory), CdtrAgt (mandatory), and Cdtr (mandatory).
PACS009_COVE_UNDERLYING_INCOMPLETE.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. The underlying customer credit transfer fields must come from the original customer payment instruction. AI cannot fabricate customer details.
PACS009_COVE_UNDERLYING_INCOMPLETE.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Underlying customer payment data is business-critical and cannot be invented — it must match the actual original customer instruction.

FXAGRD_RATE_MISSING.root_cause: pacs.008/009 CurrencyExchange26 (AgrdRate) block is present but mandatory PreAgrdXchgRate is absent. PreAgrdXchgRate is minOccurs=1 inside CurrencyExchange26.
FXAGRD_RATE_MISSING.fix: Insert <PreAgrdXchgRate>1.0</PreAgrdXchgRate> inside AgrdRate. For production, use the actual pre-agreed FX rate from the originator's FX system.
FXAGRD_RATE_MISSING.notes: AgrdRate is used when an FX conversion has been pre-agreed. PreAgrdXchgRate is always mandatory inside this block.

ADDTL_DATETIME_INVALID.root_cause: pacs.008 CdtTrfTxInf/AddtlDtTm (AdditionalDateTime1) contains invalid datetime fields. All three child elements (AccptncDtTm, PoolgAdjstmntDt, XpryDtTm) are optional but must be valid ISO dates/datetimes when present.
ADDTL_DATETIME_INVALID.fix: For AccptncDtTm and XpryDtTm: use CBPR+ datetime format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. For PoolgAdjstmntDt: use ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Apply the PAST_DATE_ERROR fix if the value is in the past.

CAMT056_ASSGNMT_CREATDTTM_INVALID.root_cause: camt.056 Assgnmt/CreDtTm is missing or has invalid format. CreDtTm is mandatory inside the Assignment block.
CAMT056_ASSGNMT_CREATDTTM_INVALID.fix: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM}</CreDtTm> as the last child of Assgnmt. Use CBPR+ offset format, no Z suffix.

CAMT057_NTF_MISSING_ID.root_cause: camt.057 Ntfctn/Id is missing. The notification ID is mandatory (minOccurs=1) in BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotificationV08.
CAMT057_NTF_MISSING_ID.fix: Insert <Id>NTFCTN-{date}-001</Id> as the first child of Ntfctn.

CAMT057_ITM_MISSING_ID.root_cause: camt.057 Ntfctn/Itm is missing the mandatory Id element.
CAMT057_ITM_MISSING_ID.fix: Insert <Id>ITM-001</Id> as the first child of the Itm block.

CAMT057_ITM_MISSING_AMT.root_cause: camt.057 Ntfctn/Itm is missing the mandatory Amt element.
CAMT057_ITM_MISSING_AMT.fix: Insert <Amt Ccy="{CCY}">{AMOUNT}</Amt> inside Itm. Harvest currency from the associated account currency or use dummy_data.amounts.default.

PACS003_DIRECTDEBIT_MISSING_MNDTID.root_cause: pacs.003 DrctDbtTxInf/DrctDbtTx/MndtRltdInf/MndtId is absent. MndtId is mandatory for direct debit transactions.
PACS003_DIRECTDEBIT_MISSING_MNDTID.fix: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED. MndtId must reference a pre-agreed mandate. AI cannot generate a valid mandate ID. Contact the creditor for the correct mandate reference.
PACS003_DIRECTDEBIT_MISSING_MNDTID.ai_cannot_fix_reason: Mandate ID must come from the creditor's mandate registry.

PAIN008_REQDCOLLTNDT_PAST.root_cause: pain.008 PmtInf/ReqdColltnDt is in the past. Direct debit collection dates must be today or in the future.
PAIN008_REQDCOLLTNDT_PAST.fix: Replace with today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

PACS010_CDTID_MISSING.root_cause: pacs.010 CdtInstr/CdtId is missing. CdtId is mandatory (minOccurs=1) in the credit instruction block.
PACS010_CDTID_MISSING.fix: Insert <CdtId>CDT-{date}-001</CdtId> as the first child of CdtInstr.

SEQUENCE_ORDER_VIOLATION.root_cause: An element appears out of XSD-mandated sequence order. ISO 20022 uses xs:sequence which is strictly ordered. XML validators will reject out-of-order elements.
SEQUENCE_ORDER_VIOLATION.fix: Reorder the elements according to the tag_insertion_order map for the parent element. For example in CdtTrfTxInf: PmtId MUST precede IntrBkSttlmAmt, ChrgBr MUST precede InstgAgt, Dbtr MUST precede DbtrAcct.

MAX_OCCURRENCE_EXCEEDED.root_cause: An element appears more times than the XSD maxOccurs allows. Examples: RgltryRptg has maxOccurs=10 in pacs.008; MemoFld has maxOccurs=2 in pain.001 cheque data.
MAX_OCCURRENCE_EXCEEDED.fix: Remove excess occurrences beyond the declared maxOccurs value. Keep the most relevant entries.

ADDRTYPE_INVALID.root_cause: PstlAdr/AdrTp/Cd contains an invalid AddressType code. Valid values are: ADDR, PBOX, HOME, BIZZ, MLTO, DLVY.
ADDRTYPE_INVALID.fix: Replace with a valid code. Default to ADDR for standard postal addresses.

CLEARINGCHANNEL_INVALID.root_cause: PmtTpInf/ClrChanl contains an invalid ClearingChannel2Code. Valid values are: RTGS, RTNS, MPNS, BOOK.
CLEARINGCHANNEL_INVALID.fix: Replace with a valid code. RTGS is standard for high-value interbank payments.

HEAD001_BIZSVC_FORMAT.root_cause: AppHdr/BizSvc value does not match the expected CBPR+ service pattern for the message type.
HEAD001_BIZSVC_FORMAT.fix: Replace BizSvc with the correct CBPR+ SR2025 service value. For pacs.008/pacs.003/pacs.004/pain.001/pain.008/pacs.009-CORE use 'swift.cbprplus.03'. For pacs.009-COV use 'swift.cbprplus.cov.03'. For camt.056/camt.057/camt.052/camt.053/camt.054/camt.055 use 'swift.cbprplus.02'. For pacs.010 use 'swift.cbprplus.ls.03'.
HEAD001_BIZSVC_FORMAT.do_not: Do NOT use the SR2024 values ending in '.02' for pacs.* (except pacs.010) or pain.* messages in SR2025.

HEAD001_TZ_DRIFT.root_cause: AppHdr/CreDt timezone offset differs from GrpHdr/CreDtTm timezone offset, indicating the two timestamps were generated at different times or in different timezones.
HEAD001_TZ_DRIFT.fix: Set both AppHdr/CreDt and GrpHdr/CreDtTm to the same UTC offset. Preferred: use +00:00 for both. If the original business timezone must be preserved, apply the same offset to both fields.
HEAD001_TZ_DRIFT.do_not: Do NOT use 'Z'. Do NOT mix +00:00 in one field with a local offset in the other.

EMPTY_PARTY_CONTAINER.root_cause: A party or agent element (Dbtr, Cdtr, InstgAgt, InstdAgt, DbtrAgt, CdtrAgt, etc.) is present in the XML but contains no identifying content — no BICFI, no Nm, no PstlAdr, no Id.
EMPTY_PARTY_CONTAINER.fix: Insert a BICFI into the FinInstnId child. For FI parties use: <FinInstnId><BICFI>AAAAGB2LXXX</BICFI></FinInstnId>. For customer parties insert minimal Id+PstlAdr: <Nm>Unknown</Nm><PstlAdr><Ctry>GB</Ctry></PstlAdr>.
EMPTY_PARTY_CONTAINER.do_not: Do NOT add both Nm/PstlAdr and BICFI to a FinInstnId (BICFI_EXCLUSIVE rule).

EMPTY_ACCOUNT_CONTAINER.root_cause: An account element (DbtrAcct, CdtrAcct, Acct) is present but its Id child contains neither IBAN nor Othr.
EMPTY_ACCOUNT_CONTAINER.fix: Insert an IBAN placeholder: <Id><IBAN>GB29NWBK60161331926819</IBAN></Id>. If the message context uses Othr: <Id><Othr><Id>00000000</Id></Othr></Id>.

ACCT_MUTUAL_EXCLUSIVITY.root_cause: Account Id contains both IBAN and Othr elements, which are mutually exclusive.
ACCT_MUTUAL_EXCLUSIVITY.fix: Remove Othr and keep IBAN. If no valid IBAN exists, remove IBAN and keep Othr instead.

ACCT_MISSING_ID.root_cause: Account Id element has neither IBAN nor Othr child.
ACCT_MISSING_ID.fix: Insert <IBAN>GB29NWBK60161331926819</IBAN> as the child of the Id element, or <Othr><Id>00000000</Id></Othr> if the message type does not use IBAN.

NAME_ADDRESS_COEXISTENCE.root_cause: A party element has Nm present but PstlAdr absent (or PstlAdr present but Nm absent). CBPR+ requires both when either is used.
NAME_ADDRESS_COEXISTENCE.fix: If Nm is present without PstlAdr: add <PstlAdr><Ctry>GB</Ctry></PstlAdr> after Nm. If PstlAdr is present without Nm: add <Nm>Unknown</Nm> before PstlAdr.
NAME_ADDRESS_COEXISTENCE.do_not: Do NOT add Nm or PstlAdr inside a FinInstnId that already has a BICFI (BICFI_EXCLUSIVE).

SEPA_BBAN_NOT_ALLOWED.root_cause: SEPA payment uses BBAN (Basic Bank Account Number) in account Othr instead of IBAN. SEPA only permits IBAN.
SEPA_BBAN_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Replace the Othr/Id BBAN value with a valid IBAN in the account Id element: <Id><IBAN>$COUNTRY_CODE + CHECK_DIGITS + BBAN</IBAN></Id>. If conversion is not possible, insert placeholder IBAN GB29NWBK60161331926819.

BBAN_VALIDATION_ERROR.root_cause: BBAN (Basic Bank Account Number) fails country-specific format or length validation.
BBAN_VALIDATION_ERROR.fix: Correct the BBAN to match the country format: GB is 22 chars (4 alpha + 6 digits + 8 digits + 2 digits), DE is 18 digits, FR is 23 chars. If format unknown, replace the account Id with IBAN placeholder.

PARTY_NAME_EMPTY.root_cause: Party Nm element is present but empty or contains only whitespace.
PARTY_NAME_EMPTY.fix: Set Nm to a non-empty placeholder. Use the context party role as the name: 'Unknown Debtor', 'Unknown Creditor', or 'Unknown Party'. Maximum 140 characters.

PARTY_NAME_LENGTH.fix: Truncate Nm to 140 characters. Preserve the most meaningful prefix (company name, not address details).

PARTY_NAME_CTRL_CHAR.root_cause: Party Nm contains C0 control characters (ASCII 0-31 except tab/LF/CR).
PARTY_NAME_CTRL_CHAR.fix: Strip all control characters (Unicode code points U+0000-U+001F except U+0009, U+000A, U+000D) from Nm. Then trim leading/trailing whitespace.

PARTY_NAME_NEWLINE.root_cause: Party Nm contains a newline character (\n or \r).
PARTY_NAME_NEWLINE.fix: Replace newlines with a single space, then collapse multiple spaces to one, and trim. Example: 'ABC\nCompany' becomes 'ABC Company'.

PARTY_NAME_XML_CHARS.root_cause: Party Nm contains unescaped XML-reserved characters (< > & " ').
PARTY_NAME_XML_CHARS.fix: Escape: & to &  < to <  > to >  " to "  ' to '

PARTY_NAME_SWIFT_CHARSET.root_cause: Party Nm contains characters outside the SWIFT MX permitted character set (non-Latin, non-ASCII printable).
PARTY_NAME_SWIFT_CHARSET.fix: Transliterate accented characters to their ASCII base (e.g. e-acute to e, u-umlaut to u, n-tilde to n). Remove remaining non-ASCII characters. See character_blocklist in the Syntactic KB for transliteration map.

PARTY_ID_DUAL.root_cause: Both OrgId and PrvtId present inside the same Id element. These are mutually exclusive.
PARTY_ID_DUAL.fix: Remove PrvtId and keep OrgId. If the party is a natural person (individual), remove OrgId and keep PrvtId instead.

PARTY_NO_ID_OR_ADDR.root_cause: Party element (Dbtr, Cdtr, UltmtDbtr, UltmtCdtr) has neither Id nor PstlAdr — the element exists but is empty.
PARTY_NO_ID_OR_ADDR.fix: Insert minimal PstlAdr: <PstlAdr><Ctry>GB</Ctry></PstlAdr>. If Nm is also absent, add <Nm>Unknown</Nm> before PstlAdr.
PARTY_NO_ID_OR_ADDR.do_not: Do NOT leave the party element completely empty.

ADDR_ADRLINE_LIMIT.root_cause: PstlAdr contains more than 2 AdrLine elements. CBPR+ SR2025 restricts to maximum 2.
ADDR_ADRLINE_LIMIT.fix: Retain the first 2 AdrLine elements and remove all subsequent ones. Concatenate the removed content into the second AdrLine if it fits within 70 characters.

ADDR_ADRLINE_EMPTY.root_cause: AdrLine element is present but empty or whitespace-only.
ADDR_ADRLINE_EMPTY.fix: Remove the empty AdrLine element entirely. Do not replace with a placeholder.

ADDR_FIELD_LENGTH.root_cause: A structured PstlAdr field (StrtNm, BldgNb, BldgNm, TwnNm, PstCd, Ctry) exceeds its maximum length.
ADDR_FIELD_LENGTH.fix: Truncate the field to its maximum: StrtNm 70 chars, BldgNb 16 chars, BldgNm 35 chars, TwnNm 35 chars, PstCd 16 chars, Ctry 2 chars (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

ADDR_FIELD_EMPTY.root_cause: A structured PstlAdr field (StrtNm, BldgNb, TwnNm, etc.) is present but empty.
ADDR_FIELD_EMPTY.fix: Remove the empty element. Do not replace with a placeholder for structured address fields.

ADDR_PREFER_STRUCTURED.root_cause: Advisory: PstlAdr uses unstructured AdrLine instead of structured fields (StrtNm, BldgNb, TwnNm, PstCd, Ctry). CBPR+ SR2025 prefers structured addresses.
ADDR_PREFER_STRUCTURED.fix: This is a warning. Optionally migrate AdrLine content to structured fields. At minimum ensure Ctry is always present.

SCHEME_CONFLICT.root_cause: SchmeNm contains both Cd and Prtry children, which are mutually exclusive.
SCHEME_CONFLICT.fix: Remove Prtry and keep Cd. If Cd is empty, remove Cd and keep Prtry.

SCHEME_MISSING_CHILD.root_cause: SchmeNm element is present but has neither Cd nor Prtry child.
SCHEME_MISSING_CHILD.fix: Insert <Cd>BBAN</Cd> for basic bank account numbers, <Cd>IBAN</Cd> for IBANs, or <Prtry>CUST</Prtry> as a generic fallback.

SCHEME_EMPTY_CD.root_cause: Cd inside SchmeNm is present but has an empty or whitespace-only value.
SCHEME_EMPTY_CD.fix: Set Cd to a valid scheme name code: 'IBAN', 'BBAN', 'CUST', 'TXID', or 'NIDN'. If no valid code is known, replace Cd with Prtry containing a non-empty string.

EMPTY_PRTRY.root_cause: Prtry element (in SchmeNm, BkTxCd, LclInstrm, etc.) is present but empty or whitespace-only.
EMPTY_PRTRY.fix: Set Prtry to a non-empty value appropriate to context: for SchmeNm use 'CUST'; for BkTxCd/Prtry/Cd use 'NOTPROVIDED'; for LclInstrm/Prtry use the clearing system short code. Remove the Prtry element only if the parent permits its absence.

T2_CURRENCY_ERROR.root_cause: Clearing system is TARGET2 (T2) but the transaction currency is not EUR. T2 only processes EUR payments.
T2_CURRENCY_ERROR.fix: Change IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy to 'EUR' and update the amount if needed. Alternatively, change the clearing system to one matching the actual currency.

CHIPS_CURRENCY_ERROR.root_cause: Clearing system is CHIPS but currency is not USD. CHIPS only processes USD.
CHIPS_CURRENCY_ERROR.fix: Change IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy to 'USD', or change clearing system to match the actual currency.

FED_CURRENCY_ERROR.root_cause: Clearing system is Fedwire (FED) but currency is not USD.
FED_CURRENCY_ERROR.fix: Change IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy to 'USD', or change clearing system.

CHAPS_CURRENCY_ERROR.root_cause: Clearing system is CHAPS but currency is not GBP. CHAPS only processes GBP.
CHAPS_CURRENCY_ERROR.fix: Change IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy to 'GBP', or change clearing system.

CLRSYSREF_EMPTY.root_cause: ClrSysRef element is present but empty.
CLRSYSREF_EMPTY.fix: Either remove the ClrSysRef element entirely, or populate it with a valid clearing system reference. Format depends on clearing system: T2 uses 21 chars, CHIPS uses up to 16 chars.

CLRSYSREF_DUPLICATE.root_cause: More than one ClrSysRef element found within a single PmtId. Only one is permitted.
CLRSYSREF_DUPLICATE.fix: Keep the first ClrSysRef and remove all subsequent duplicates.

CLRSYSREF_FORBIDDEN.root_cause: ClrSysRef is present but no clearing system (T2/CHAPS/CHIPS/FED) is identified in SttlmInf. ClrSysRef is only valid when a specific clearing system is nominated.
CLRSYSREF_FORBIDDEN.fix: Either remove ClrSysRef, or add ClrSys identification to SttlmInf: <ClrSys><Cd>T2</Cd></ClrSys> (or the appropriate system).

CLRSYSREF_RECOMMENDED.root_cause: Advisory: A clearing system is specified in SttlmInf but no ClrSysRef is provided. ClrSysRef is recommended for T2/CHAPS/CHIPS/FED to enable end-to-end tracking.
CLRSYSREF_RECOMMENDED.fix: This is a warning. Consider adding ClrSysRef under PmtId.

STTLMPRTY_EMPTY.root_cause: SttlmPrty element is present but has an empty or whitespace-only value.
STTLMPRTY_EMPTY.fix: Set SttlmPrty to 'HIGH' for RTGS/CHAPS/T2 payments or 'NORM' for standard priority.

STTLMPRTY_INVALID.root_cause: SttlmPrty value is not one of the two valid codes: HIGH or NORM.
STTLMPRTY_INVALID.fix: Replace value with 'HIGH' or 'NORM'. Use 'HIGH' for same-day RTGS/CHAPS/TARGET2 payments; 'NORM' otherwise.

STTLMPRTY_WRONG_PARENT.root_cause: SttlmPrty is placed outside CdtTrfTxInf (e.g., directly in GrpHdr or Document). CBPR+ requires it inside the transaction block.
STTLMPRTY_WRONG_PARENT.fix: Move SttlmPrty to be a child of CdtTrfTxInf, immediately after IntrBkSttlmDt.

STTLMPRTY_DUPLICATE.root_cause: More than one SttlmPrty element found inside CdtTrfTxInf.
STTLMPRTY_DUPLICATE.fix: Keep the first SttlmPrty and remove all subsequent duplicates.

STTLMPRTY_WRONG_POSITION.root_cause: SttlmPrty is not positioned immediately after IntrBkSttlmDt in CdtTrfTxInf element order.
STTLMPRTY_WRONG_POSITION.fix: Move SttlmPrty to appear directly after the IntrBkSttlmDt element within CdtTrfTxInf.

RTGS_STTLMPRTY_RECOMMENDED.root_cause: Advisory: Payment routed via RTGS clearing system but SttlmPrty is NORM or absent. HIGH is recommended for RTGS.
RTGS_STTLMPRTY_RECOMMENDED.fix: This is a warning. Consider setting SttlmPrty to HIGH.

PACS009_RMT_001.root_cause: RmtInf (remittance information) is present in a pacs.009 CORE message. RmtInf is forbidden in the standard FI-to-FI credit transfer; it is only allowed in the COV (cover) variant.
PACS009_RMT_001.fix: Remove the RmtInf element entirely. If the payment is a cover for an underlying customer transfer, ensure BizSvc is 'swift.cbprplus.cov.03' and add UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf instead of bare RmtInf.

PACS002_RMT_001.root_cause: RmtInf is present in a pacs.002 or pain.002 payment status report message. Status messages must not carry remittance information.
PACS002_RMT_001.fix: Remove the RmtInf element from the status report.

GLOBAL_RMT_UST_LEN.fix: Truncate Ustrd to 140 characters. Preserve the most relevant information (reference/invoice number) at the start.

GLOBAL_RMT_FINX.root_cause: RmtInf/Ustrd contains characters outside the SWIFT FIN X permitted character set.
GLOBAL_RMT_FINX.fix: Remove or transliterate non-FIN-X characters. FIN X allows: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + space newline.

GLOBAL_RMT_ADDTL_OCCUR.root_cause: More than 3 AddtlRmtInf elements present inside a single Strd block. Maximum is 3.
GLOBAL_RMT_ADDTL_OCCUR.fix: Remove excess AddtlRmtInf elements, keeping the first 3. Merge content into the 3rd element if it fits within 140 characters.

GLOBAL_RMT_SCOR.root_cause: Creditor reference using SCOR scheme does not follow ISO 11649 format. ISO 11649 references start with 'RF', followed by 2 check digits, then 1-21 alphanumeric chars (total 4-25 chars).
GLOBAL_RMT_SCOR.fix: Correct the reference to start with 'RF' + 2 check digits + reference. If the original reference is unknown, use placeholder 'RF18539007547034'.

GLOBAL_RMT_INVCR_LEN.root_cause: Invoicer Nm exceeds 140 characters inside RmtInf/Strd.

GLOBAL_RMT_INVCEE_LEN.root_cause: Invoicee Nm exceeds 140 characters inside RmtInf/Strd.

GLOBAL_RMT_RFRDDOC_LEN.fix: Truncate the document number to 35 characters.

GLOBAL_RMT_004.root_cause: Advisory: RmtInf uses Ustrd (unstructured) only. From November 2025, CBPR+ strongly recommends structured remittance (Strd/CdtrRefInf) for improved STP rates. From November 2027, structured remittance becomes mandatory.
GLOBAL_RMT_004.fix: This is a warning. Consider migrating to structured remittance: <RmtInf><Strd><CdtrRefInf><Tp><CdOrPrtry><Cd>SCOR</Cd></CdOrPrtry></Tp><Ref>$REF</Ref></CdtrRefInf></Strd></RmtInf>

SR2025_PURP_NO_CD.root_cause: Purp element is present but has no Cd child. Either Cd or Prtry is required.
SR2025_PURP_NO_CD.fix: Insert <Cd>SUPP</Cd> as a default purpose code, or use the appropriate code for the payment context. Common codes: SUPP (supplier payment), SALA (salary), TRAD (trade), GDDS (goods).

SR2025_PURP_EMPTY_CD.fix: Set Cd to a valid ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code. Common codes: SUPP, SALA, TRAD, GDDS, INTC, CORT. See per-message KB for message-specific valid codes.

SR2025_PURP_INVALID_CODE.root_cause: Purp/Cd value is not a valid ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code.
SR2025_PURP_INVALID_CODE.fix: Replace with a valid code. Common valid codes: SUPP (supplier payment), SALA (salary), TRAD (trade), GDDS (goods), INTC (intra-company), CORT (corporate trade), TAXS (tax payment), PENS (pension), CHAR (charitable).

SR2025_CTGYPURP_NO_CD.root_cause: CtgyPurp is present but has no Cd child.

SR2025_CTGYPURP_EMPTY_CD.fix: Set Cd to a valid ExternalCategoryPurpose1Code: SUPP, SALA, CASH, SECU, TRAD, CORT.

SR2025_CTGYPURP_INVALID_CODE.root_cause: CtgyPurp/Cd is not a valid ExternalCategoryPurpose1Code.
SR2025_CTGYPURP_INVALID_CODE.fix: Replace with a valid code: SUPP, SALA, CASH, SECU, TRAD, CORT.

CBPR_JSON_PATTERN.root_cause: CBPR+ JSON schema pattern violation — a field value does not match the required regex pattern.
CBPR_JSON_PATTERN.fix: Check the field against its pattern in field_constraints. Common patterns: BICFI ^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z2-9][A-NP-Z0-9]([A-Z0-9]{3})?$, IBAN ^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{1,30}$, UETR ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$.
CBPR_JSON_PATTERN.do_not: Do NOT guess a valid value. Regenerate the field using dummy_data if the original is unrecoverable.

CBPR_JSON_MAX_LENGTH.fix: Truncate the field value to its maxLength. For IDs and references: 35. For names: 140. For address lines: 70. Check field_constraints for the specific field.

CBPR_JSON_MIN_LENGTH.root_cause: CBPR+ JSON schema minLength violation — field value is too short.
CBPR_JSON_MIN_LENGTH.fix: Pad or correct the field to meet minimum length. For BICFI minimum is 8 characters. For ISO dates minimum is 10 (YYYY-MM-DD). Check field_constraints for the specific field.

CBPR_JSON_ENUM.root_cause: CBPR+ JSON schema enum violation — value is not in the allowed enumeration.
CBPR_JSON_ENUM.fix: Replace with a valid enumeration value. Check the per-message KB for valid_values lists. Common enums: ChrgBr (DEBT/CRED/SHAR/SLEV), SttlmMtd (INDA/INGA/CLRG/COVE), CdtDbtInd (CRDT/DBIT).

CBPR_JSON_CCY_PATTERN.root_cause: Currency code in a CBPR+ JSON schema validation fails the pattern [A-Z]{3}.
CBPR_JSON_CCY_PATTERN.fix: Replace with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter uppercase currency code. Common codes: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, CAD. Check currency.json for the full list.

DTD_FORBIDDEN.root_cause: XML document contains a DOCTYPE declaration (<!DOCTYPE ...>). DTD declarations are forbidden in ISO 20022 CBPR+ messages for security reasons (XXE injection risk).
DTD_FORBIDDEN.fix: Remove the entire <!DOCTYPE ...> block from the document.
DTD_FORBIDDEN.do_not: Do NOT preserve or rewrite the DTD — remove it entirely. ISO 20022 messages never use DTDs.
DTD_FORBIDDEN.security_note: DTDs enable XML External Entity (XXE) attacks. Their presence may indicate document tampering.

ENTITY_FORBIDDEN.root_cause: XML document contains an entity declaration (<!ENTITY ...>). Entity declarations are forbidden in ISO 20022 CBPR+ messages.
ENTITY_FORBIDDEN.fix: Remove the <!ENTITY ...> declaration. Replace any entity references in content with their literal values.
ENTITY_FORBIDDEN.security_note: Custom entity declarations can be used for Billion Laughs (entity expansion) denial-of-service attacks.

CUT001.root_cause: Message submission time is after the cutoff time for the specified payment system or value date.
CUT001.fix: This is a timing/operational error — no field value change will resolve it. Change IntrBkSttlmDt to the next valid business day, or resubmit the message before the cutoff. Check cutoff_timings.json for system-specific cutoffs.
CUT001.do_not: Do NOT alter timestamps to appear within cutoff — this would be falsification.

CUT002.root_cause: IntrBkSttlmDt falls on a non-business day (weekend or bank holiday).
CUT002.fix: Change IntrBkSttlmDt to the next valid business day. For CHAPS: Monday-Friday excluding UK bank holidays. For T2: Monday-Friday excluding TARGET2 holidays.

CUT004.root_cause: Settlement or execution date is too far in the future or violates the advance-booking window for the payment system.
CUT004.fix: Set IntrBkSttlmDt to today or the next business day. Maximum advance booking varies by system; default to today + 1 business day if unsure.

WHITESPACE_ERROR.root_cause: Field value has leading or trailing whitespace, or internal whitespace in a strict token field (BICFI, IBAN, amount, date).
WHITESPACE_ERROR.fix: Trim leading and trailing whitespace. For strict token fields (BICFI, IBAN, amount, currency code, date) also remove all internal whitespace.

INVALID_CHARSET.root_cause: Field value contains characters outside the CBPR+ RestrictedFINXMax35Text / RestrictedFINMax140Text permitted set. Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 space / - ? : ( ) . , ' + ONLY. All other characters are forbidden including: ! @ # $ % ^ & * _ { } [ ] | ; < > " ~ ` = and non-ASCII/Unicode.
INVALID_CHARSET.fix: Strip ALL forbidden characters from the field value, keeping only the CBPR+ permitted set: A-Z a-z 0-9 space / - ? : ( ) . , ' + . If stripping leaves the field empty, replace with 'Unknown'. Do NOT delete the element — preserve the tag with a cleaned value.
INVALID_CHARSET.do_not: Do NOT delete the element or the entire parent block. Do NOT replace with empty string. Do NOT keep the original forbidden characters. Do NOT hallucinate a new value — strip only.
INVALID_CHARSET.scope: GLOBAL — applies to ALL text-bearing leaf elements in any message type: Nm, StrtNm, TwnNm, BldgNm, AdrLine, DstrctNm, CtrySubDvsn, TwnLctnNm, ClrSysRef, BldgNb, PstCd, Dept, SubDept, Flr, Room, PstBx, Ustrd, AddtlInf, and any other free-text field.

SWIFT_CHARSET_WARN.root_cause: Advisory: Ustrd or free-text field contains characters outside the SWIFT FIN charset but within Unicode. Not an error in MX but may cause issues if the message is converted to MT.
SWIFT_CHARSET_WARN.fix: This is a warning. Consider restricting to SWIFT FIN X charset: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + space.

CURR_IBAN_MISMATCH.root_cause: Transaction currency (Ccy attribute on IntrBkSttlmAmt or InstdAmt) does not match the expected currency for the IBAN country in DbtrAcct or CdtrAcct. Two common causes: (1) the original IBAN country implies a different currency than Ccy (e.g. DE IBAN → EUR but Ccy=SEK); (2) AI auto-generated a dummy IBAN using the default country (GB → GBP) when the payment currency is EUR, causing GB IBAN + EUR Ccy mismatch.
CURR_IBAN_MISMATCH.fix: SCENARIO 1 (original IBAN is real): Update the Ccy attribute on the amount element to match the currency expected for the IBAN country. Use dummy_data.currencies_by_country to map IBAN country prefix → currency. SCENARIO 2 (dummy IBAN was generated): Replace the dummy IBAN with one whose country currency matches the Ccy attribute — consult dummy_data.ibans and dummy_data.currencies_by_country to pick the right country. E.g. Ccy=EUR → use DE IBAN (DE89370400440532013000).
CURR_IBAN_MISMATCH.anti_pattern: Do NOT generate a GB IBAN (GB29NWBK60161331926819) as a default when the payment Ccy is EUR or any non-GBP currency. Do NOT change both the IBAN and the Ccy attribute simultaneously without knowing which is correct. Always check Ccy on the nearest amount element before generating a dummy IBAN.
CURR_IBAN_MISMATCH.prevention: When generating any dummy IBAN, first read the Ccy attribute on IntrBkSttlmAmt/InstdAmt/Amt in the same message. Then use dummy_data.currencies_by_country to find a country whose expected currency matches Ccy. Use that country's IBAN from dummy_data.ibans. If no match found, use DE (EUR, most common cross-border currency) as fallback instead of GB.
CURR_IBAN_MISMATCH.applies_to: all message types: pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.003, pacs.004, pain.001, pain.008, camt.052, camt.053, camt.054, camt.057
CURR_IBAN_MISMATCH.example: Payment has Ccy=EUR on IntrBkSttlmAmt. AI deletes IBAN. Regeneration must pick DE (EUR) not GB (GBP). Result: DE89370400440532013000, not GB29NWBK60161331926819.

SvcLvl_Cd_INVALID.root_cause: The <Cd> element under <SvcLvl> contains an invalid or empty service level code. Valid codes are from the ExternalServiceLevel1Code codelist: SEPA, NURG, URGP, SDVA, G001, G002, etc.
SvcLvl_Cd_INVALID.fix: Replace <Cd> text with a valid ExternalServiceLevel1Code value. For CBPR+ messages use NURG or URGP. For SEPA use SEPA. Do NOT use freeform text like 'for'.
SvcLvl_Cd_INVALID.anti_pattern: Do NOT insert arbitrary text. Do NOT use 'for', 'null', 'unknown' or any non-code value in <Cd>.

AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_PURPOSE_LIMIT.root_cause: Transaction amount exceeds the limit configured for the payment purpose code in the validation rules.
AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_PURPOSE_LIMIT.fix: This is a business rule violation. Review the amount and purpose code. Either correct the amount or use an appropriate purpose code with a higher permitted limit. No deterministic fix — requires manual review.

HIGH_VALUE_TRANSACTION.root_cause: Advisory: Transaction amount exceeds the high-value threshold configured for monitoring purposes.
HIGH_VALUE_TRANSACTION.fix: This is a warning only — no fix needed. Ensure appropriate authorization and compliance checks have been completed for this high-value payment.

INVALID_IBAN_CTRY.root_cause: IBAN first two characters are not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
INVALID_IBAN_CTRY.fix: Correct the first two characters to a valid country code (e.g., GB, DE, FR, NL, BE, CH, IT, ES, SE, NO, DK, PL, AT). If the correct country is unknown, use GB as a placeholder.

UNSUPPORTED_IBAN_CTRY.root_cause: IBAN country code refers to a country that does not use IBANs (e.g., US, CA, AU, JP, CN, IN, MX). These countries use account numbers in Othr/Id format.
