UNSUPPORTED_IBAN_CTRY.fix: Replace IBAN with Othr/Id containing the account number: <Othr><Id>$ACCOUNT_NUMBER</Id></Othr>. If the actual account number is unknown, use placeholder 00000000.
UNSUPPORTED_IBAN_CTRY.do_not: Do NOT use IBAN for US/CA/AU/JP/CN accounts — these countries have no IBAN scheme.

NON_POSITIVE_AMOUNT.root_cause: Amount value is zero or negative. All interbank settlement amounts and instructed amounts must be strictly positive (> 0).
NON_POSITIVE_AMOUNT.fix: Replace the amount with a positive value. Use 1000.00 as a placeholder if the correct value is unknown. Note: zero amounts are allowed ONLY in ChrgsInf when no charges apply.
NON_POSITIVE_AMOUNT.do_not: Do NOT set amount to 0 unless the field is specifically ChrgsInf/Amt in a no-charge scenario.

DUPLICATE_ID_VALUE.root_cause: The same ID value is used more than once in the message where uniqueness is required. Applies to: MsgId, EndToEndId, UETR, InstrId, TxId.
DUPLICATE_ID_VALUE.fix: Generate a new unique value for the duplicate. For UETR: use a new UUID v4. For MsgId/EndToEndId/InstrId: append a suffix like '-2' or regenerate. Do NOT copy IDs from other messages.

MISSING_STRUCTURE.root_cause: The XML document lacks the expected top-level structure: no BusMsgEnvlp root, or no AppHdr, or no Document element.
MISSING_STRUCTURE.fix: Reconstruct the missing top-level structure. A well-formed CBPR+ message must have: <BusMsgEnvlp><AppHdr>...</AppHdr><Document>...</Document></BusMsgEnvlp>. Use tag_templates to insert missing AppHdr or Document wrappers.
MISSING_STRUCTURE.do_not: Do NOT place Document elements inside AppHdr or AppHdr elements inside Document.

tag_templates._doc: Exact XML structure for each tag, by message type. The AI MUST use the message-specific variant when available; fall back to 'default' only when no message match. Placeholders ($VAR) get resolved by either harvesting from the live XML or pulling from dummy_data.

UETR._note: The $UETR placeholder resolves to a freshly generated UUID v4 (str(uuid.uuid4())) — never to a static value. Mandatory in pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.003, pacs.010. Insert inside PmtId after EndToEndId. See payment_id_coexistence.rules.PMTID_REQUIRES_UETR_CBPRPLUS.

BizMsgIdr._note: Must equal GrpHdr/MsgId — always harvest from the live message.

BizSvc._note: All message types in this implementation use 'swift.cbprplus.02'. The auto_fix_rule CBPR_R8_CAMT057_BIZSVC enforces this for camt.057 specifically. Never generate 'swift.cbprplus.03' — it triggers CBPR_R8 failures in the bulk generator.

PstlAdr._note: Minimal CBPR+ postal address. AdrLine (unstructured) + Ctry is the simplest valid form. Do NOT add AdrTp unless explicitly required — it adds schema complexity. Country defaults to US if not derivable from BICFI/IBAN context.

FinInstnId._note: Under CBPR+, if BICFI is present, Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed at the same level.

PmtMtd._note: TRF = credit transfer (pain.001); DD = direct debit (pain.008). Using TRF in a pain.008 fails the PmtMtd codelist.

OrgnlGrpInfAndSts._note: OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId are both mandatory. OrgnlMsgNmId must match the message family of the original (e.g. pacs.008.001.08).

InitgPty._note: InitgPty in pain.001/pain.008 GrpHdr is mandatory. Harvest debtor name from PmtInf/Dbtr/Nm.

Cretr._note: Cretr uses Pty (with mandatory Nm when AnyBIC/BICFI absent) or Agt. When no BICFI is available, Pty/Nm is mandatory per CBPR+ rules.

Pty._note: Pty requires Nm when AnyBIC is absent. PstlAdr with at least TwnNm and Ctry is recommended.

SttlmTmIndctn._note: Must contain EITHER CdtDtTm (credit transfer) OR DbtDtTm (direct debit) — NEVER both. Format: CBPR+ offset datetime, no Z, no milliseconds.

ClrSysMmbId._note: Cannot coexist with BICFI in the same FinInstnId. $CLRSYS_CD: USABA (US, 9 digits), GBDSC (UK, 6 digits), BLZDE (DE, 8 digits). Use only when BICFI is unavailable.

MndtRltdInf._note: MndtId MUST reference a pre-agreed mandate from the creditor's mandate registry. AI CANNOT generate a valid MndtId — this requires human input from the creditor.

UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf._note: COV variant only (SttlmMtd=COVE). REQUIRES real customer payment data — Dbtr/Cdtr names, IBANs, and remittance info must match the original customer instruction. AI CANNOT invent these values for production use; dummy data only acceptable for testing.

InstrForCdtrAgt._note: Valid Cd values: CHQB, HOLD, PHOB, TELB, SDVA, INTC, CORT, REPA. HOLD + PHOB are mutually contradictory — do not combine. Never include more than 2 InstrForCdtrAgt blocks.

RgltryRptg._note: Jurisdiction-specific. US FinCEN: use code 'CRED' with Inf field. EU AML Directive: specific codes per country. AI CANNOT generate compliant regulatory reporting content — human compliance review required.

BtchBookg._note: When true, all CdtTrfTxInf in this message must share the same IntrBkSttlmDt. AI fix: default to false unless operator explicitly requests batch booking.

RtrRsnInf.pacs.004: <RtrRsnInf><Rsn><Cd>FOCR</Cd></Rsn><AddtlInf>Payment returned at request of ordering customer</AddtlInf></RtrRsnInf>
RtrRsnInf._note: Common return reason codes: FOCR (by ordering customer), AC01 (account closed), AM04 (insufficient funds), MD01 (no mandate). Use semantically correct code for production — not dummy.

ReqdExctnDt._note: pain.001 PmtInf/ReqdExctnDt is a DateAndDateTime2Choice — must contain either <Dt> (ISODate) or <DtTm> (ISODateTime). The <Dt> form is preferred. $STTLM_DT resolves to today's date.

AddtlDtTm._note: pacs.008 optional AdditionalDateTime1 block. All three child elements (AccptncDtTm, PoolgAdjstmntDt, XpryDtTm) are optional. Include only when needed.

AgrdRate._note: Pre-agreed exchange rate block. PreAgrdXchgRate is mandatory inside AgrdRate. Use only when a pre-agreed FX deal exists.

UndrlygAllcn._note: pacs.009 transaction allocation block. Optional repeating element. Used when settlement amount is allocated across multiple underlying payments.

PmtSgntr._note: Optional cryptographic signature for ILP/SHA-256. CryptographicKey1Choice: use ILPV4 (hex) or Sgntr (base64). AI cannot generate a valid cryptographic signature — human/system must supply this.

TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt._note: pacs.004 GrpHdr mandatory field. Must NOT exceed the IntrBkSttlmAmt of the original payment. Currency must match the original. AI cannot verify the amount ceiling without original message context.

RtrInf._note: pacs.004 return information block referencing the original payment.

PmtId_pain001._note: pain.001 PmtId uses PaymentIdentification6 which has InstrId (optional) and EndToEndId (mandatory). UETR is also optional but allowed.

tag_insertion_order._doc: XSD-mandated element order inside each parent. When inserting a missing tag, place it AFTER the last existing sibling that appears before it in this list. AI must respect this order to produce schema-valid XML.

dependencies._doc: Cross-field invariants the AI must preserve when generating fixes.

equals.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal the underlying message's GrpHdr/MsgId.
equals.fix_action: When generating either field, harvest the other; never invent a new value.

equals.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must exactly equal the message ID in the Document's xmlns.
equals.fix_action: Read the xmlns of the Document root and copy the message id (e.g. pacs.008.001.08).

equals.description: AppHdr/Fr BICFI must equal CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt BICFI (when CpyDplct not COPY/CODU).
equals.fix_action: Harvest the InstgAgt BICFI from the transaction block and set AppHdr/Fr to match.

equals.description: AppHdr/To BICFI must equal CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt BICFI.
equals.fix_action: Harvest the InstdAgt BICFI from the transaction block and set AppHdr/To to match.

equals.description: AppHdr/Fr BICFI must equal Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt BICFI in cancellation messages (when CpyDplct not COPY/CODU).
equals.fix_action: Harvest the Assgnr Agt BICFI from the Assignment block and set AppHdr/Fr to match.

equals.description: AppHdr/To BICFI must equal Assgnmt/Assgne/Agt BICFI in cancellation messages (when CpyDplct not COPY/CODU).
equals.fix_action: Harvest the Assgne Agt BICFI from the Assignment block and set AppHdr/To to match.

equals.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the actual count of transaction blocks.
equals.fix_action: Count transaction blocks in the document and set NbOfTxs accordingly.

equals.description: AppHdr/Prty must equal CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty when both present.
CtrlSum must equal the sum of all transaction amounts in the message.
equals.fix_action: Sum all IntrBkSttlmAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.

not_equal.description: Debtor Agent BIC and Creditor Agent BIC should not be identical (loopback warning).
not_equal.fix_action: When generating either, harvest the other and choose a different bank from dummy_data.banks.

conditional_required.description: Every PstlAdr block must have at least a Ctry element.
AppHdr/Fr (the sender) is mandatory in the Business Application Header. If absent, insert it as the first child of AppHdr.
conditional_required.fix_action: Insert tag_templates.Fr with $INSTG_BICFI harvested from InstgAgt//BICFI; fall back to dummy_data.parties.instructing_agent.bicfi.

conditional_required.description: AppHdr/To (the receiver) is mandatory in the Business Application Header. If absent, insert it after Fr.
conditional_required.fix_action: Insert tag_templates.To with $INSTD_BICFI harvested from InstdAgt//BICFI; fall back to dummy_data.parties.instructed_agent.bicfi.

conditional_required.description: pacs.009 COV variant: SttlmMtd=COVE requires a complete UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf block with Dbtr, Cdtr, DbtrAcct, CdtrAcct, and RmtInf.
conditional_required.fix_action: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED — UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf content must be supplied by the originating bank. AI cannot generate valid underlying customer data.

then_forbidden: The combination of RmtInf.Strd and RmtInf.Ustrd in the same block
conditional_required.description: RmtInf must contain either Strd (structured) OR Ustrd (unstructured), not both. XSD allows one or the other.
conditional_required.fix_action: Remove Ustrd when Strd is present. Remove Strd when only free-text is available. Preferred: Strd with CdtrRefInf when a reference number exists.

conditional_required.description: SttlmTmIndctn must contain exactly one of CdtDtTm (credit leg timing) or DbtDtTm (debit leg timing), never both and never neither.
conditional_required.fix_action: For credit transfers (pacs.008/009): use CdtDtTm. For direct debits (pacs.003): use DbtDtTm. Remove the incorrect element. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (CBPR+ offset, no Z).

then_required: All CdtTrfTxInf blocks must share the same IntrBkSttlmDt
conditional_required.description: When BtchBookg=true, all transactions in the batch settle as a single entry. All IntrBkSttlmDt values across CdtTrfTxInf blocks must be identical.
conditional_required.fix_action: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED — operator must choose a single IntrBkSttlmDt for all transactions. AI cannot determine the intended batch settlement date.

exclusive.description: Under CBPR+, if BICFI is present, Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed inside the same FinInstnId.
exclusive.fix_action: When adding a BICFI, remove any sibling Nm and PstlAdr inside the same FinInstnId.

exclusive.description: Account identifier must use either IBAN or Othr, not both.
CBPR+ and ISO 20022 XSD: if ClrSysMmbId is used for agent identification, BICFI must NOT also be present inside the same FinInstnId. Choose one identification method only.
exclusive.fix_action: Remove ClrSysMmbId (and parent ClrSys block) when BICFI is present — BICFI is the preferred CBPR+ identifier. Remove BICFI if domestic clearing system identification is intentional.
exclusive.do_not: Do NOT keep both — the XSD schema will reject the message.

exclusive.description: When ClrSysMmbId is used, the parent ClrSysId/Cd must identify the clearing system (e.g., USABA, GBDSC, BLZDE). MmbId format is system-specific and invalid without knowing the system.
exclusive.fix_action: Add ClrSysId/Cd before validating MmbId format. Common codes: USABA (US ABA 9 digits), GBDSC (UK sort code 6 digits), BLZDE (DE 8 digits), CHBCC (CH 5 digits), CACPA (CA 9 digits).

then_required: Cdtr IBAN country must be SEPA member
exclusive.description: SEPA payments (SvcLvl=SEPA) require the creditor's IBAN country to be a SEPA reachability country. Non-SEPA IBANs (US, IN, SG, etc.) will be rejected by the SEPA payment network.
exclusive.fix_action: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED — if payment is genuinely cross-border, change SvcLvl from SEPA to the appropriate code (G002 for CBPR+). If truly SEPA, the creditor IBAN must be from a SEPA country.

exclusive.description: camt.056 FIToFIPaymentCancellationRequest: Assgnmt (Assignment) is mandatory at root level. Must contain Id, Assgnr, Assgne, CreDtTm.
camt.055 CustomerPaymentCancellationRequest: Assgnmt is mandatory. Must contain Id, Assgnr, Assgne, CreDtTm.
pacs.004 GrpHdr requires TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt and IntrBkSttlmDt both at group header level.
exclusive.fix_action: TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt: use tag_templates.TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt — must not exceed original. IntrBkSttlmDt: use today's date.

exclusive.description: pacs.002 GroupHeader101 does NOT include NbOfTxs. The field exists only in GroupHeader131 (pacs.008) and similar. If present in pacs.002, it must be removed.
exclusive.fix_action: Remove NbOfTxs from GrpHdr when message is pacs.002.

exclusive.description: pain.001 PmtInf/ReqdExctnDt must contain EITHER <Dt> OR <DtTm> — it is a DateAndDateTime2Choice. A bare text content or missing child element is invalid.
exclusive.fix_action: Wrap the date value inside <Dt>YYYY-MM-DD</Dt> as a child of ReqdExctnDt. Default to <Dt> form.

exclusive.description: pacs.009 UndrlygFICdtTrf (CreditTransferTransaction69) has mandatory PmtId, IntrBkSttlmAmt, Dbtr, and Cdtr.
exclusive.fix_action: Populate mandatory fields inside UndrlygFICdtTrf from the outer CdtTrfTxInf block or dummy_data.

agent_account_coexistence._doc: CBPR+ rule: an agent's account element can only exist when the corresponding agent element is present. If the account is present but the agent is missing, either insert the agent or remove the account. AI should insert the agent using dummy_data.banks.

rules.fix_action: Insert IntrmyAgt1 using tag_templates.IntrmyAgt1 before IntrmyAgt1Acct, or remove IntrmyAgt1Acct if no intermediary is needed.
Insert IntrmyAgt2 before IntrmyAgt2Acct.
Insert IntrmyAgt3 before IntrmyAgt3Acct.
Insert DbtrAgt using tag_templates.DbtrAgt before DbtrAgtAcct.
Insert CdtrAgt using tag_templates.CdtrAgt before CdtrAgtAcct.
Insert InstgRmbrsmntAgt with BICFI from dummy_data.banks before InstgRmbrsmntAgtAcct.
Insert InstdRmbrsmntAgt with BICFI from dummy_data.banks before InstdRmbrsmntAgtAcct.

party_coexistence._doc: Cross-party presence rules. Ultimate parties presuppose their base party. If UltmtDbtr is present, Dbtr must also be present (and vice versa for Cdtr). AI should insert the missing base party.

rules.fix_action: Insert Dbtr block using tag_templates.Dbtr before UltmtDbtr in the transaction block.
Insert Cdtr block using tag_templates.Cdtr after CdtrAgt but before UltmtCdtr.
Insert DbtrAgt using tag_templates.DbtrAgt. The debtor's bank is required in pacs.008 customer credit transfers.
Insert DbtrAcct using tag_templates.DbtrAcct with IBAN from dummy_data.ibans matching the debtor's country.

payment_id_coexistence._doc: PmtId child element requirements. EndToEndId is always mandatory. UETR is mandatory for CBPR+ pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.003, pacs.010. TxId is mandatory for pacs.008 and pacs.009.

uetr_generation_rule._doc: CRITICAL: UETR MUST be generated using uuid.uuid4() at fix time — NEVER use a static/hardcoded value. The fix engine calls _inject_fresh_uetrs() automatically on all templates. The KB dummy_data.ids.UETR is for documentation only and MUST NOT be reused across transactions.
uetr_generation_rule.uniqueness: Each UETR must be unique globally. Never copy a UETR from one message to another.

rules.fix_action: Insert <EndToEndId>E2E-{date}-001</EndToEndId> as the first child of PmtId. Use dummy_data.ids.EndToEndId format.
Generate a fresh UUID v4 via uuid.uuid4() and insert <UETR>{uuid}</UETR> inside PmtId after EndToEndId. NEVER reuse a static UUID.
Insert <TxId>TXN-{date}-001</TxId> after EndToEndId but before UETR inside PmtId.

charges_coexistence._doc: ChrgsInf element coexistence rules. When charges are declared, both amount and agent must be present.

rules.fix_action: If ChrgsInf.Amt is missing: insert <Amt Ccy="{IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy}">0.00</Amt>. If ChrgsInf.Agt is missing: insert <Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{InstgAgt BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt>.
Update ChrgsInf/Amt/@Ccy to match IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy.

status_report_coexistence._doc: pacs.002 status message element coexistence rules.

rules.fix_action: Insert <OrgnlEndToEndId>{harvest from document or use dummy_data.ids.OrgnlEndToEndId}</OrgnlEndToEndId> as first child of TxInfAndSts.
Insert StsRsnInf using tag_templates.StsRsnInf. For production, use the actual rejection reason code — not the dummy AC01.
Insert OrgnlMsgId using dummy_data.ids.OrgnlMsgId. Insert OrgnlMsgNmId with the appropriate message name (e.g. pacs.008.001.08 for a pacs.008 original).

cancellation_coexistence._doc: camt.056 cancellation message element coexistence rules.

rules.fix_action: At minimum, insert <OrgnlUETR>{original payment UETR}</OrgnlUETR>. For testing use dummy_data.ids.UETR_alt1. For production, harvest from original message.
Insert <CxlRsnInf><Rsn><Cd>DUPL</Cd></Rsn></CxlRsnInf>. Use DUPL for duplicate payment cancellations, AGNT for bank-initiated cancellations, CUST for customer request.

fininstnid_identification_options._doc: A FinInstnId must use exactly ONE identification method: BICFI, ClrSysMmbId, LEI, or Nm+PstlAdr. Only BICFI or ClrSysMmbId are allowed without the other. If Nm is present without BICFI/ClrSysMmbId/LEI, PstlAdr is also required.

rules.fix_action: Add BICFI from dummy_data.banks as the preferred identification method. BICFI is required under CBPR+ for all cross-border payments.

rules.if: exists(FinInstnId.Nm) and not exists(FinInstnId.BICFI) and not exists(FinInstnId.ClrSysMmbId) and not exists(FinInstnId.LEI)
rules.fix_action: Insert PstlAdr with at least TwnNm and Ctry inside FinInstnId when Nm is the only identifier (CBPR+ Agent Option 3).
When using ClrSysMmbId without BICFI in a cross-border message: add Nm and PstlAdr (CBPR+ Agent Option 2). For domestic-only messages this may be waived.

auto_fix_rules._doc: Declarative repair rules the AI Fix engine reads to auto-fix structural/business validation issues across ALL ISO 20022 message types. Matched by error code OR message regex; the engine applies the named fix_action and revalidates. Add new rules here — no code change required.

reposition.message_pattern: is not expected at this position
reposition.description: An element is at the wrong hierarchy level (not a valid child of its parent) but one of the parent's child containers allows it per the XSD. The engine moves the element (preserving its value) into that container, builds the container's template children, and reorders both levels to the XSD sequence. Resolved dynamically from the XSD type map — works for all message types.
examples: FinInstnId/Ctry -> FinInstnId/PstlAdr/Ctry (Ctry is not a direct child of FinInstnId; PstlAdr allows it)

duplicate.description: An element appears more than once where the schema allows it once (e.g. two <BICFI> in one FinInstnId). Keep the first valid (non-empty) occurrence; remove the rest. Also triggered when a sequence error names an element that already appears earlier in the same parent.

enumeration.description: Replace an invalid enumeration value with a schema-valid one. The allowed set is read from the validator message ('must be one of: A, B'); `preferred` is used when it is in that set, else the first listed value. pacs.009 GrpHdr/SttlmMtd allows only INDA/INGA (COVE forbidden there).

predecessor.message_pattern: PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present.*PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present
predecessor.description: pacs.009 COV: if PrvsInstgAgt3 is present, PrvsInstgAgt2 must be present (validator uses long name PreviousInstructingAgent3/2).

predecessor.message_pattern: PreviousInstructingAgent2 is present.*PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present

predecessor.description: IntrmyAgt2 requires IntrmyAgt1 before it (CBPR+ agent ordering, all payment messages).

exclusive.description: If BICFI is present in FinInstnId, Nm and PstlAdr are not allowed → remove them.
If AnyBIC is present, Nm and PstlAdr are not allowed → remove them.

coexistence.description: Nm and PstlAdr must both be present; if the block also has BICFI, remove the lone one (exclusivity wins), else add the missing counterpart.

value_replacement.description: CBPR_R8 fires for camt.057 when BizSvc is wrong. The correct value for camt.057 in this implementation is always 'swift.cbprplus.02'. Set BizSvc to this value regardless of what the error message says the expected value should be.

When the validator is configured for SR2023/SR2024 (pacs.008.001.08/09/10/11/12), replace swift.cbprplus.03 with swift.cbprplus.02. IMPORTANT: Do NOT apply for SR2025 documents (pacs.008.001.13+) — they REQUIRE swift.cbprplus.03.
value_replacement.version_note: SR2023/SR2024 = .02, SR2025 = .03. Match BizSvc to the XSD version in the namespace URI.

value_replacement.description: When the validator is configured for SR2025 (pacs.008.001.13, pacs.009.001.12, etc.), replace swift.cbprplus.02 with swift.cbprplus.03.
value_replacement.version_note: SR2025 requires swift.cbprplus.03. Check the document namespace to determine the correct version.

value_replacement.description: Replace invalid AddressType code with ADDR (standard postal address).
Replace invalid ClearingChannel code with RTGS (high-value real-time gross settlement).

empty_mandatory.description: A BICFI element is present but has no content. Fix engine must either: (a) populate with a valid 8/11-char BIC if one can be inferred from context (e.g. matching InstgAgt/InstdAgt), or (b) remove the entire parent agent block if that agent position is optional and not required by the payment chain. NEVER leave an empty BICFI in the output.
empty_mandatory.priority_logic: If agent is DbtrAgt or CdtrAgt (mandatory in CBPR+), populate from context or flag as CANNOT_AUTO_FIX. If agent is PrvsInstgAgt1/2/3 or IntrmyAgt1/2/3 with empty BICFI, remove entire block.

empty_mandatory.description: SvcLvl/Cd element present but empty. Either populate with a valid ExternalServiceLevel1Code (default: SDVA for same-day value) or remove the entire <SvcLvl> block if service level is not applicable. Do NOT leave empty <Cd> tag.

An Othr/Id element is present but empty. Used in account identifiers (DbtrAcct, CdtrAcct, IntrmyAgtAcct, DbtrAgtAcct, CdtrAgtAcct). Fix: if the parent account has no meaningful identifier, remove the entire parent account block. If it should reference an account, populate with a dummy reference (e.g. ACCT-UNKNOWN). NEVER leave empty Othr/Id.
empty_mandatory.priority_logic: Account blocks for optional agents (IntrmyAgtAcct with empty account) should be removed entirely. Account blocks for mandatory parties (DbtrAcct, CdtrAcct) should be populated.

empty_mandatory.description: NbOfTxs is present but empty. Engine counts CdtTrfTxInf (or TxInfAndSts) blocks and inserts the count. Applies to pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, pain.001, pain.008.
InstrId present but empty. Generate a unique Max16Text identifier. Must not start/end with '/' or contain '//'. Use pattern: INSTR-{6-char-alphanum}.

decimal_overflow.description: ISO 20022 amount fields have XSD constraint fractionDigits=5 (ActiveCurrencyAndAmount / ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount). However, SWIFT CBPR+ network and most bank systems only support 2 decimal places. When an amount has more than 5 decimal digits, the XSD itself rejects it; when it has 3-5, SWIFT may reject at network level. Fix: round to 2 decimal places using standard rounding (half-up). Preserve the Ccy attribute. Never change the integer part beyond rounding.
critical_notes: NEVER remove or change the Ccy attribute
Round to 2 decimal places for monetary amounts
For XchgRate/BaseOneRate: round to 5 decimal places (not 2)
Always use period (.) as decimal separator — never comma
Do NOT change the integer portion unless pure rounding requires it (e.g. .9999... rounds up)

structural_repair.description: RmtInf element found inside UltmtCdtr, Cdtr, or Dbtr party blocks — these party elements do NOT allow RmtInf as a child. RmtInf is only valid as a direct child of CdtTrfTxInf. Move the RmtInf block (including Ustrd/Strd content) to its correct position as a child of CdtTrfTxInf. Also: UltmtCdtr allowed children are only Nm, PstlAdr, Id, CtryOfRes, CtctDtls.

AppHdr/To/FIId/FinInstnId block missing or malformed (e.g. closing tag mismatch like </FIId> used instead of </FinInstnId></FIId>). Reconstruct with the BIC from CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI (per CBPR_R2/R3).
critical_notes: AppHdr/To BICFI must match CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt BICFI
Common XML error: closing tag </FIId> used prematurely before </FinInstnId>

structural_repair.description: CdtrAgtAcct element is structurally broken (e.g. mismatched closing tags, orphaned </Id> tag, truncated element like </CdtrAg). Fix: rebuild the element from the tag_templates KB. If the account identifier is empty, remove the entire block.
critical_notes: If Id is empty and account is optional, remove entire <CdtrAgtAcct> block
Malformed closing tag like </CdtrAg is an XML parse error — must be corrected to </CdtrAgtAcct>

wrap_element.description: If ReqdExctnDt contains bare text (a date without a child Dt/DtTm element), wrap it: <ReqdExctnDt><Dt>{value}</Dt></ReqdExctnDt>.

country_repair._doc: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country-code repair for <Ctry>/<CtryOfRes>/<CtryOfBirth>. A value is valid only if it is in resources/codelists/country.json (250 codes) — NOT merely two uppercase letters (e.g. 'UK' and 'UN' match [A-Z]{2} but are NOT valid ISO codes; the ISO code for the United Kingdom is 'GB'). For an invalid/empty value the engine resolves, in order: (1) alias map below, (2) a valid country code harvested from elsewhere in the document, (3) `default`. Applies to AppHdr (head.001) and all business messages.

dummy_data._doc: High-quality reusable sample values. AI should harvest from the live document first and only fall back to this dictionary when the document has no matching value.

ids._UETR_NOTE: NEVER use a static UETR value. Always call str(uuid.uuid4()) at fix time. The fix engine's _inject_fresh_uetrs() handles this automatically for all _TEMPLATES entries.
ids._UETR_ALT_NOTE: Alt UETRs are also always freshly generated — never hardcoded.

dates._note: USE_TODAY and USE_NOW_OFFSET are sentinel values — the AI must substitute the actual current date/datetime at fix time.
dates.today_comment: Replace USE_TODAY with the actual current date in YYYY-MM-DD format
dates.settlement_comment: Settlement date is typically today or T+1; use today's date as minimum
dates.now_offset_comment: Replace USE_NOW_OFFSET with YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 using current UTC

ibans._note: US/IN/SG/AU/CA/JP are NOT IBAN-scheme countries; these point to valid IBANs from real IBAN countries so the fixer's fallback never emits an invalid (checksum/country) IBAN. Real accounts in these countries use <Othr>, not <IBAN>.

placeholder_resolution._doc: Maps tag_templates $VARIABLES to harvest/default actions. Applied in order: 1) harvest_from_xml, 2) dummy_data path, 3) constant default.

$UETR._note: CRITICAL: UETR is NEVER a static dummy. If no existing UETR can be harvested from the live XML, generate a new UUID v4 via str(uuid.uuid4()). The fix engine's _inject_fresh_uetrs() handles this automatically. Each transaction must have its own unique UETR.

$CRE_DT_TM._note: MUST be current date/time with +HH:MM offset, NO 'Z', NO milliseconds.

$STTLM_DT._note: Must be today or future, YYYY-MM-DD format only.

cbpr_plus_rules._doc: SWIFT CBPR+ specific rules that go beyond XSD schema validation. The AI must apply all of these when the BizSvc is swift.cbprplus.02.

mandatory_fields._doc: AppHdr.Fr and AppHdr.To are CBPR+ mandatory for ALL message types — not just pacs.008. The head.001 XSD marks them optional (min=0) but CBPR+ rules require them. Removing Fr/To must trigger re-insertion for pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, pacs.003, pacs.004, pacs.010, pain.001, pain.002, pain.008, camt.052, camt.053, camt.054, camt.055, camt.056, camt.057.

datetime_rules: The 'Z' suffix is strictly forbidden — use +00:00 for UTC
The timezone offset must be a valid UTC offset between -14:00 and +14:00
address_rules: When BICFI is present in FinInstnId, Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present at the same FinInstnId level
PstlAdr must contain either: (a) up to 2 AdrLine elements + Ctry, or (b) structured fields (StrtNm, BldgNb, TwnNm, PstCd, Ctry)
Ctry must always be present in PstlAdr
AdrLine maximum: 2 occurrences, each max 70 characters
Nm maximum: 140 characters, SWIFT character set only
name_address_coexistence: If Nm is present, a PstlAdr must also be present in the same party block
If PstlAdr is present, Nm must also be present in the same party block (for customer parties)

ai_cannot_fix._doc: Definitive catalogue of scenarios where the AI fix engine CANNOT produce a correct automated fix. For each, the AI must return the error with fix_action='MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED' and supply the human_guidance hint. No auto-fix should be attempted for these codes.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: AI cannot determine whether the IBAN or the BIC reflects the true payment routing intent. Only the message originator knows which is correct.
scenarios.human_guidance: Compare the IBAN country prefix (positions 1–2) with the BIC country code (positions 5–6 of the 8/11-char BIC). Correct whichever field is wrong based on the intended payment corridor.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when IBAN chars 1-2 != BIC chars 5-6 within the same party block (Dbtr+DbtrAgt or Cdtr+CdtrAgt).
scenarios.example: DbtrAcct IBAN=DE89... but DbtrAgt BICFI=CHASUS33XXX (US bank) — Germany IBAN with US bank is suspicious.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: Correct correspondent banking chain requires knowledge of bilateral correspondent agreements. AI cannot determine which intermediary is redundant.
scenarios.human_guidance: Remove the duplicate intermediary whose BICFI matches InstgAgt or InstdAgt. Verify the intended routing with the correspondent banking department.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when IntrmyAgt1/2/3 BICFI == InstgAgt BICFI or == InstdAgt BICFI.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: AI cannot determine whether to align all transactions to the earliest, latest, or a specific settlement date without operator instruction.
scenarios.human_guidance: Choose a single IntrBkSttlmDt for all transactions in the batch. Apply that date to every CdtTrfTxInf block. Common choice: earliest date in the batch to ensure all settle on time.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when BtchBookg=true and count of distinct IntrBkSttlmDt values across CdtTrfTxInf > 1.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf requires the original customer payment details (names, IBANs, remittance). These are business data from the originating bank — not derivable from the cover payment alone.
scenarios.human_guidance: Retrieve the original customer credit transfer instruction (typically pain.001 or MT103) and extract: Dbtr/Nm, Dbtr/PstlAdr, DbtrAcct/IBAN, Cdtr/Nm, Cdtr/PstlAdr, CdtrAcct/IBAN, and RmtInf. Populate UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf with this data.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when Document contains FIToFICstmrCdtTrf and SttlmMtd=COVE but no UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf child exists.
scenarios.testing_only_workaround: For test messages only: insert a dummy UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf using tag_templates.UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf with dummy_data values — clearly mark as TEST.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: The maximum returnable amount depends on the original payment, which may be in a separate session, database, or SWIFT archive. AI has no cross-message amount lookup.
scenarios.human_guidance: Look up the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 using the OrgnlUETR or OrgnlMsgId. Set TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt to the exact original IntrBkSttlmAmt (full return) or less (partial return, net of charges).
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt is present in pacs.004 and cannot be cross-validated against a known original.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: Verifying that OrgnlMsgId/OrgnlUETR refer to a real sent message requires a payment ledger or SWIFT message archive — not available to the AI engine.
scenarios.human_guidance: Search the payment archive for OrgnlMsgId or OrgnlUETR. Confirm the original message was sent and not already returned/cancelled before processing this return/cancellation.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger on pacs.004, camt.056, camt.055 when original references cannot be verified.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: Mandate IDs are assigned by the creditor's mandate management system and must reference a signed, pre-existing authorisation from the debtor. These cannot be generated by AI.
scenarios.human_guidance: Retrieve the MndtId from the creditor's mandate registry. DtOfSgntr must be the date the debtor signed the mandate — verify from the signed mandate form.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger on pain.008 when DrctDbtTx/MndtRltdInf is absent or MndtId is empty/dummy.
scenarios.regulatory_note: Under SEPA Direct Debit, using an invalid MndtId is a compliance violation and can result in R-transactions (MD01/MD07).

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: Correct statement balances require access to the bank's account ledger. The opening balance, closing balance, and all debit/credit entries must reconcile — AI cannot access account history.
scenarios.human_guidance: Recalculate: OpeningBalance + sum(credits) - sum(debits) = ClosingBalance. Correct whichever balance figure or Ntry amounts are wrong by referring to the actual account movements.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger on camt.052/053/054 when Bal types OPBD and CLBD are present and their difference != sum of Ntry/Amt.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: SEPA reachability is a network rule — AI cannot change the payment to a non-SEPA corridor without understanding the operator's intent (is it truly a non-SEPA payment, or a data entry error?)
scenarios.human_guidance: If the payment is cross-border (non-SEPA): change SvcLvl from SEPA to G002 and use pacs.008 instead of pain.001. If it should be SEPA: correct the creditor IBAN to a SEPA country account.
scenarios.sepa_member_countries_note: SEPA includes 36 countries (EU27 + EEA + UK + CH + MC + SM + VA + GI). IBANs from non-SEPA countries (US, IN, SG, CN, JP, AU, etc.) cannot receive SEPA payments.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when SvcLvl=SEPA and CdtrAcct IBAN chars 1-2 are not in the SEPA member country list.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: The correct rejection reason code (StsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd) reflects why the payment actually failed — information only the processing bank possesses. A dummy code (e.g., AC01) is structurally valid but semantically misleading.
scenarios.human_guidance: Use the rejection reason from the bank's payment processing system. See error_code_catalogue.PACS002_REJECTION_CODE_SEMANTIC.common_reason_codes for the ISO 20022 code list.
scenarios.testing_note: AC01 (account closed) is acceptable as a test dummy. For production, always use the actual rejection reason.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: MT field 72 is a legacy free-format field with bank-specific conventions. Multiple /code/ lines in the same field can map to different MX elements depending on the sending bank.
scenarios.human_guidance: Map each /code/ line manually: /BNF/=InstrForCdtrAgt or RmtInf; /ACC/=CdtrAcct; /INS/=IntrmyAgt1; /RFB/=RmtInf/Strd; /ROC/=GrpHdr reference. When ambiguous, preserve in RmtInf/Ustrd and document the decision.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger on MT103→pacs.008 conversion when tag 72 contains more than one /code/ line or uses non-standard codes.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: OFAC, EU, UN, and HMT sanctions lists are updated daily. AI has a static BIC registry snapshot from OpenSanctions which is insufficient for production compliance screening.
scenarios.human_guidance: Before processing live payments: submit all party identifiers (BIC, LEI, name, country, IBAN) to your institution's real-time sanctions screening system. Do NOT rely solely on the validator's BIC check.
scenarios.static_check_limitation: The BIC_NOT_FOUND warning flags deregistered BICs but does NOT guarantee sanctions compliance.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: Instruction code compatibility rules depend on bilateral agreements between correspondent banks and are not part of the ISO 20022 standard.
scenarios.human_guidance: Review the instruction codes against the receiving bank's service documentation. Remove contradictory codes (e.g., HOLD + PHOB). Confirm the instruction with the originating bank's correspondent team.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when InstrForCdtrAgt contains HOLD combined with any other code, or when 3+ InstrForCdtrAgt blocks are present.

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: Real-time exchange rates cannot be generated by AI. The correct rate must come from the bank's FX trading system at the time of payment.
scenarios.human_guidance: Obtain the spot rate from your FX system. Use at minimum 4 decimal places (e.g., 1.2345). For CLS-settled currencies, use the rate from the CLS rate set on the settlement date.
scenarios.testing_note: For testing, '1.0000' is acceptable. Production messages must use actual market rates.
scenarios.detection_hint: Flag when XchgRate is '1.0' or '1' and InstdAmt.Ccy != IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy (genuine cross-currency transaction, not just a trivial rate).

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: The BusMsgEnvlp wrapper with namespace 'urn:swift:xsd:envelope' is a SWIFT proprietary envelope that wraps the ISO 20022 payload. Removing it requires: (1) stripping the outer element, (2) re-rooting namespace declarations from BusMsgEnvlp onto the child AppHdr/Document, (3) extracting and repositioning the Document payload if it was incorrectly nested inside AppHdr. This is a structural rewrite — not a field-level fix — and carries a high risk of namespace or data corruption if done incorrectly by AI.
scenarios.human_guidance: Restructure the XML manually: remove <BusMsgEnvlp> and </BusMsgEnvlp>, then ensure the result has AppHdr and Document as separate sibling root elements. If the message body (e.g. CstmrDrctDbtInitn) is nested inside AppHdr, move it into a separate <Document xmlns='urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:{msg_type}'> element.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when root element local-name is 'BusMsgEnvlp' OR root namespace URI contains 'swift:xsd:envelope'.

real_example.problem: Root is <BusMsgEnvlp xmlns='urn:swift:xsd:envelope'> wrapping <AppHdr> which itself incorrectly contains <CstmrDrctDbtInitn>
real_example.error_message: The namespace 'urn:swift:xsd:envelope' does not match the ISO 20022 standard format. Use the correct URN format (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pacs.008.001.08)
secondary_errors: AppHdr is missing BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt
CstmrDrctDbtInitn is nested inside AppHdr instead of in a <Document> element
The To element and CstmrDrctDbtInitn appear as children of AppHdr — mixed structural error from the envelope format

scenarios.why_ai_cannot_fix: A message-specific root element (e.g. CstmrDrctDbtInitn, FIToFICstmrCdtTrf) appearing inside AppHdr is a fundamental structural error. Moving it out requires: determining the correct Document namespace, transferring namespace declarations, and ensuring no AppHdr elements are accidentally included. AI cannot perform this safely without risking data loss.
scenarios.human_guidance: Cut the message root element (e.g. <CstmrDrctDbtInitn>...</CstmrDrctDbtInitn>) from inside AppHdr. Paste it inside a new <Document xmlns='urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.008.001.08'> element placed AFTER the closing </AppHdr> tag.
scenarios.detection_hint: Trigger when CstmrDrctDbtInitn, FIToFICstmrCdtTrf, FinInstnCdtTrf, FIToFIPmtStsRpt, CstmrCdtTrfInitn, FIToFICstmrDrctDbt, PmtRtr, FIDrctDbt, BkToCstmrAcctRpt, BkToCstmrStmt, BkToCstmrDbtCdtNtfctn, CstmrPmtCxlReq, FIToFIPmtCxlReq, or NtfctnToRcv appears as a direct child of AppHdr.
scenarios.note: This error often co-occurs with BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE. Fix the envelope structure first, then check whether the Document was correctly separated from AppHdr.

auto_fix_boundary_rules._doc: These rules define the boundary between what the AI fix engine can and cannot handle. Engine must check these before attempting any fix.
CAN_AUTO_FIX: Missing mandatory structural elements with known templates (MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD, APPHDR_FR_MISSING, APPHDR_TO_MISSING)
Value format errors with codelist (CHRGBR_INVALID, SCHEMENAME_INVALID, INVALID_CHARSETS)
BIC/IBAN format errors where a dummy value is acceptable (UETR_FORMAT_ERROR, IBAN_INVALID, INVALID_BICFI)
Cross-field equality fixes where both values are present (BIZMSGIDR_EQ_GRPHDR_MSGID, APPHDR_FR_NEQ_INSTGAGT)
Counter corrections where the count is computable (NBOFTXS_MISMATCH, CTRL_SUM_MISMATCH, EMPTY_NBOFNTRIES, EMPTY_PGINFO)
BICFI exclusivity fixes (BICFI_EXCLUSIVE — remove Nm and PstlAdr)
Intermediary ordering (IntrmyAgt2 without IntrmyAgt1 — insert IntrmyAgt1)
CANNOT_AUTO_FIX: Any fix requiring knowledge of a different message (cross-message references)
Any fix requiring real-time external data (exchange rates, sanctions, balance)
Any fix requiring business intent determination (which field is wrong when two contradict)
Any fix involving mandate data, regulatory reporting, or compliance decisions
Any fix where the correct value must come from a bank system (ledger, archive, FX system)
BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE — removing BusMsgEnvlp wrapper and restructuring the document envelope
DOCUMENT_NESTED_IN_APPHDR — extracting a message root element from inside AppHdr into a sibling Document element

known_fix_behaviors._doc: Observed behavioral constraints and edge cases for the AI fix engine. Field-tested limitations. Fix engine MUST read before applying any structural or value fix.

structural_edit_behaviors.description: The surgical unclosed-tag fix (_try_surgical_unclosed_tag_fix) and the recovery router both only triggered on lxml-style messages like 'Unclosed tag <X> before the closing tag </Y> at line N'. A second message format exists from user-facing validators: 'Add </X> to close the open tag at line N before the </FIId> closing tag at line N'. This format was NOT matched by either the routing condition or the surgical regex.
structural_edit_behaviors.behavior: Message format B caused the XML recovery pipeline to be skipped entirely — the broken XML fell through to _parse_xml, which silently recovered via lxml recover=True and discarded the malformed FinInstnId structure, producing wrong output.
structural_edit_behaviors.root_cause: Routing condition checked only 'unclosed' in msg.lower(). Format B contains 'close the open tag' and 'add </' — neither matched.
structural_edit_behaviors.fix_engine_guidance: Routing condition now also checks: 'close the open tag' in msg.lower() and ('add </' in msg.lower() and 'closing tag' in msg.lower()). The surgical regex now matches both format A and format B.
structural_edit_behaviors.format_a: Unclosed tag <FinInstnId> ... before the closing tag </FIId> ... at line 13
structural_edit_behaviors.format_b: Add </FinInstnId> to close the open tag at line 13 before the </FIId> closing tag at line 13
structural_edit_behaviors.detection_pattern: Check both formats when routing XML recovery. Both map to: missing_tag=FinInstnId, conflict_tag=FIId, conflict_line=13.

structural_edit_behaviors.description: If user appends '!' to tag name or content (e.g. <Amt>100!</Amt> or <Tag!>), lxml structural recovery REMOVES the tag entirely instead of repairing it. Affects all message types including camt.052 and camt.054.
structural_edit_behaviors.behavior: Tag dropped from recovered XML — data loss
structural_edit_behaviors.root_cause: lxml recover=True silently discards tags with non-XML characters when they cannot be parsed
structural_edit_behaviors.fix_engine_guidance: Pre-process XML: strip '!' from text content or tag names before passing to lxml recovery. Do NOT rely on Stage-2 recovery for this case.
structural_edit_behaviors.detection_pattern: Detect '!' in tag text or tag name before recovery

structural_edit_behaviors.description: If user deletes entire tag (opening + content + closing), fix engine cannot recover it. Element is simply absent from tree.
structural_edit_behaviors.behavior: Engine sees no evidence of missing element; cannot determine value without context
structural_edit_behaviors.fix_engine_guidance: When validator reports MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD for element not present, use tag_templates KB for insertion. Fall back to field_constraints dummy values. Do NOT attempt value inference from context alone.
structural_edit_behaviors.related: CANNOT_AUTO_FIX — only fixable via MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD template insertion

structural_edit_behaviors.description: If user deletes only tag name but leaves content (element renders as unrecognized local-name), fix engine CAN repair: value and position still present in tree.
structural_edit_behaviors.behavior: lxml parses with fallback local-name; content accessible and positionally identifies intended element
structural_edit_behaviors.fix_engine_guidance: Identify element by positional context (parent path + sibling order). Reconstruct correct tag name from parent's expected child sequence per XSD or KB template.

value_fix_bugs.description: _value_for_datatype() returns '1000.00' for any field whose datatype contains 'decimal' or 'amount'. This OVERWRITES existing correct amounts with 1000.00 when unrelated errors trigger a value fix.
observed_cases: pain.001: InstrAmt changed to 1000.00 or '1000,100' (comma-decimal corruption)
pacs.008: IntrBkSttlmAmt changed to 1000.00 during other structural fixes
camt.052/054: Amt fields changed to 1000.00 when fixing other errors in same block
value_fix_bugs.fix_engine_guidance: NEVER overwrite existing non-zero amount with 1000.00. Only apply default when field is empty or missing. Preserve existing Amt/@Ccy attribute. For InstrAmt: always preserve existing value.
value_fix_bugs.critical_rule: If el.text already matches ^\d+\.\d+$, do NOT replace it. Only replace empty, null, or non-numeric values.

value_fix_bugs.description: pain.001 InstrAmt being changed to '1000,100' (comma as thousands separator). Locale-specific decimal formatting bug.
value_fix_bugs.fix_engine_guidance: All ISO 20022 decimals use period (.) as decimal separator per xs:decimal. Never use comma. If generating default: '1000.00'. If preserving: validate ^\d+\.\d+$ before keeping.

value_fix_bugs.description: SLEV is NOT valid for ChrgBr in CBPR+ messages. ChrgBr valid values: DEBT, CRED, SHAR only. SLEV removed from ChrgBr enumeration in ISO 20022 SR2019+. When SLEV appears in ChrgBr it must be replaced with SHAR.
value_fix_bugs.fix_engine_guidance: When ChrgBr contains SLEV, replace with SHAR. Never insert SLEV into ChrgBr in templates. ChrgBr template: '<ChrgBr>SHAR</ChrgBr>'. SLEV is valid only in SvcLvl/Cd context.

per_message_known_issues.description: Adding '!' at end of any tag content in camt.052 causes tag to be silently dropped during structural recovery. Same root cause as EXCL_BANG_REMOVES_TAG.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Pre-process XML: strip '!' from text content before lxml recovery.

per_message_known_issues.description: Adding ',4' at end of tag content (e.g. <Amt Ccy='USD'>500,4</Amt>) causes validation failure. Bare comma ',' in same position passes. Locale decimal separator issue.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Treat ',4' as malformed decimal. Strip comma and trailing digit, preserve integer part, append '.00'. E.g. '500,4' becomes '500.00'. Always use period as decimal separator.

per_message_known_issues.description: pain.001 amount fields (Amt, InstdAmt, CtrlSum, EqvtAmt) reset to 1000.00 when unrelated errors trigger value fix. InstrAmt set to '1000,100' (locale bug).
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: In pain.001: skip value fix for any *Amt element that already has valid decimal. For InstrAmt: never regenerate value — only fix format (period vs comma). Never change numeric value itself.

per_message_known_issues.description: Error: 'The element Document is not expected here. Either it is not allowed in this specification, or another mandatory element is missing before this one. One of the following elements is expected: Sgntr, Rltd'
per_message_known_issues.root_cause: Document element appearing as child of AppHdr instead of sibling. AppHdr and Document must be SIBLING root elements at document level. Or AppHdr missing closing tag causing Document to parse as child.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: 1. Check if Document nested inside AppHdr — restructure as siblings. 2. Check if AppHdr unclosed (Stage-0 surgical fix). 3. Do NOT add Sgntr or Rltd — they are optional; the error message 'expected' list is misleading. Real fix is correct sibling structure.

per_message_known_issues.description: User has a BusMsgEnvlp-wrapped message where Document is incorrectly nested inside AppHdr. When the user removes the AppHdr opening and closing tags entirely (leaving Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt, Prty, and Document as direct children of BusMsgEnvlp), the AI fix engine CANNOT re-add the AppHdr wrapper. The engine has no record of AppHdr ever existing — the entire structural container is absent.

real_example.what_fix_engine_sees: BusMsgEnvlp with orphaned AppHdr children (Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, etc.) at root level — no AppHdr element present to anchor the fix

per_message_known_issues.why_ai_cannot_fix: The fix engine cannot determine which direct children of BusMsgEnvlp belonged to AppHdr vs. which were already at root level. Wrapping the wrong set of children would produce a structurally different (and equally invalid) document. This requires human judgment.
per_message_known_issues.compounding_problem: This structure also has Document nested inside AppHdr (before tag removal). So even if AppHdr were re-added, the Document would still be wrongly nested inside it instead of being a sibling. Two separate restructuring steps are required.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Do NOT attempt to auto-insert AppHdr when: (a) root is BusMsgEnvlp AND (b) AppHdr is not present as a direct child. Flag as CANNOT_AUTO_FIX and surface BUSMSGENVLP_INVALID_NAMESPACE error with human_guidance.
human_guidance_steps: Step 1 — Restore AppHdr wrapper: Add <AppHdr xmlns='urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:head.001.001.02'> immediately after <BusMsgEnvlp> and </AppHdr> before <Document>. The AppHdr children are: Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt, Prty.
Step 2 — Fix Document placement: Move <Document> outside AppHdr so it is a SIBLING, not a child. The correct structure has AppHdr closed before Document opens.
Step 3 — Remove BusMsgEnvlp wrapper: Remove outer <BusMsgEnvlp> and </BusMsgEnvlp>. Re-root namespace declarations from BusMsgEnvlp onto AppHdr if needed.
per_message_known_issues.detection_hint: Trigger when root is BusMsgEnvlp AND AppHdr is absent AND Fr/To/BizMsgIdr are direct children of BusMsgEnvlp.

per_message_known_issues.description: InstdAmt or ChrgsInf/Amt values with excessive decimal precision (e.g. 388658.9999999999999999999999906) fail XSD validation (fractionDigits=5). These are floating-point precision artifacts from amount calculation systems.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Round to 2 decimal places using HALF_UP rounding. The near-integer values like .9999... WILL round up the integer part — this is correct and expected. Preserve Ccy attribute. Never use comma as decimal separator.

per_message_known_issues.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm with invalid date portion like '2026-06-084T10:00:00+00:00' (day has 3 digits: '084' instead of '08'). This is a typo — extra digit inserted. XML parsers accept it as text but XSD date validation rejects the malformed ISO 8601 date.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Pattern: detect YYYY-MM-DDdT where 'DD' is more than 2 digits. Fix: replace with today's datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format. Do NOT try to parse the invalid date — replace entirely.

per_message_known_issues.description: PrvsInstgAgt1/2/3 or IntrmyAgt1/2/3 blocks present with only an empty <BICFI></BICFI> — no identifying information at all. These are optional agents in the payment chain. An agent block with no content is schema-invalid and adds no routing information.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Remove the entire agent block when it contains only empty BICFI and no other identifying data. Removal triggers chain validation: if PrvsInstgAgt3 has a value but PrvsInstgAgt2 is removed, the predecessor chain rule (PRVS_INSTG_CHAIN_3) will require PrvsInstgAgt2 to be present — in that case, keep PrvsInstgAgt2 and flag it as CANNOT_AUTO_FIX.
per_message_known_issues.chain_rule: PrvsInstgAgt3 requires PrvsInstgAgt2; PrvsInstgAgt2 requires PrvsInstgAgt1. IntrmyAgt2 requires IntrmyAgt1.

per_message_known_issues.description: RmtInf block found as a child of UltmtCdtr instead of CdtTrfTxInf. UltmtCdtr is a PartyIdentification element (allows Nm/PstlAdr/Id/CtryOfRes/CtctDtls only). RmtInf placed there causes schema error 'element RmtInf not expected here'.
per_message_known_issues.fix_engine_guidance: Move <RmtInf> from inside <UltmtCdtr> to be a direct child of <CdtTrfTxInf>. Also: if the Ustrd element is empty, either populate with a placeholder ('Payment') or omit the block. Empty <Ustrd></Ustrd> inside RmtInf is also schema-invalid (minLength=1).
